text: Lunis, iscientziados dae s’ iscola de Meighina de s’Universidade de Stanford ant annuntziadu s’inventzione de un’aina noa de diàgnosi chi podet classificare sas tzèllulas pro genia: un’ischeda minuda e chi si podet imprentare, chi si podet fraigare impreende imprentadoras a tinta istandard pro unu tzentèsimu de dòllaru cada una, prus o mancu.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Sos printzipales chircadores narant chi custu diat pòdere batire a una diàgnosi primidia de càntzeru, tubercolòsi, HIV e malària in patzientes dae paisos a rèdditu bassu, in ue sas mèdias de vida pro maladias comente càntzeru de mama podent èssere sa metade de sos paisos ricos.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Su JAS 39C Gripen nch’est rutu subra de una pista fache a sas 9.30 ora locale (0230 UTC) e est iscopiadu, serrende s’aeroportu a sos bolos cummertziales.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Su pilota l’ant identificadu comente su cumandante de iscuadra Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Sos media locales relatant de una vetura de su servìtziu de su fogu de s’aeroportu furriadu mentras respondiat.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal, 28 annos, fiat lòmpidu a su Bartzellona tres istagiones a como, dae su Sivìglia.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Dae cando si fiat tramudadu in sa capitale catalana, Vidal aiat giogadu 49 partidas pro s’iscuadra.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Sa protesta est cumintzada fache a sas 11:00 ora locale (UTC+1) in Whitehall in antis de s’intrada bardiada dae sa politzia in Downing Street, sa residèntzia uffitziale de su Primu Ministru.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Apenas a pustis de sas 11:00, sas protestas ant blocadu su tràficu in diretzione nord in Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: A sas 11:20, sa politzia at pedidu a sas pessones chi protestaiant de torrare in su martzapiedi, narende chi depiant bilantzare su deretu a sa protesta cun sa crèschida de su tràficu.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Fache a sas 11:29, sa protesta at tramudadu dae Whitehall, propassadu Trafalgar Square, oru oru de sa Strand, passende pro Aldwych fintzas a Kingsway fache a Holborn, in ue su Partidu cunservadore fiat faghende su Forum de Beranu in s’albergu Grand Connaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Su record de Nadal fache a pare cun su canadesu est de 7-2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Dae pagu at pèrdidu contra Raonic in s’Open de Brisbane.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal at regortu 88% puntos a rete in sa partida, binchende 76 puntos in su primu serbìtziu.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: A pustis de sa partida, su Re de sa Terra ruja at naradu: “So birbilliadu pro èssere torradu in sas partes finales de sos torneos prus de importu. So inoghe pro proare a lu bìnchere”.
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: “Panama Papers” est un’espressada paracu pro belle deghe milliones de documentos de s’istùdiu legale de Pànama Mossack Fonseca, colados a sos media in su beranu de su 2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Sos documentos mustrant chi batòrdighi bancas aiant agiudadu clientes potentes a cuare miliardos de dòllaros de richesa pro evitare impostas e àteras leges.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Su giornale britànnicu The Guardian at inditadu chi sa Deutsche Bank at controlladu prus o mancu unu tèrtziu de 1200 cumpangias fitìtzias impreadas pro custu fine.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: B’at àpidu protestas in totu su mundu, paritzas atziones legales, e sos capos de sos guvernos de Islanda e de Pàkistan ant dadu sas dimissiones.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Nàschidu in Hong Kong, Ma at istudiadu in s’Universidade de New York e in s’Iscola de Deretu de Harvard e una borta aiat tentu una “carta birde” comente residente permanente americanu.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh at insinuadu durante sas eletziones chi Ma diat pòdere lassare su paisu in unu tempus de crisi.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh at afirmdu puru chi su fotogènicu Ma fiat prus istile che nono sustàntzia.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Cuntantu de custas acusas, Ma at bìnchidu in manera fàtzile in una prataforma chi sustenet ligàmenes prus istrintos cun su continente tzinesu.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Su Giogadore de sa Die de oe est Alex Ovechkin de sos Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: At fatu 2 gol e 2 assistèntzias in sa vitòria pro 5-3 de Washington contra sos Atlanta Thrashers.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Sa prima assistèntzia de sa note de Ovechkin est istada pro su puntu de sa vitòria de su debutante Nicklas Backstrom;
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: su de duos gol de sa note est istadu su de 60 suos in s’istagione, e est divènnidu su primu giogadore a fàghere 660 o prus gol in un’istagione dae su 1995-96, cando Jaromir Jagr e Mario Lemieux sunt lòmpidos a custu record.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten est a su 190mu postu de sa lista de sas 400 pessones prus ricas de s’Amèrica in su 2008, cun unu patrimòniu carculadu de $2.3 miliardos.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: At pigadu sa làurea in s’Iscola de Artes e Sièntzias de s’Universidade de Virginia in su 1950 e fiat unu donadore de importu mannu pro s’istitutzione.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: A sa presone irachena de Abu Graib ll ant postu fogu durante una revoltada.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Sa presone est devènnida famada cando sunt istados iscobertos abusos subra sas pessones presoneras a pustis de s’arribada de sas fortzas de sos Istados Unidos.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr at tzacadu in su Gran Prèmiu de Singapore in su 2008 apenas a pustis de unu pit stop pro Fernando Alonso, faghende essire sa vetura de seguresa.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Comente sas veturas in antis de Alonso sunt intradas pro ghetare carburante cun sa vetura de seguresa, issu at otènnidu positziones pro lòmpere a sa vitòria.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Picket Jr est istadu lissentziadu a pustis de su Gran Prèmiu de Ungheria de su 2009.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: A sas 8.46 a.m. unu silèntziu fiat rutu subra sa tzitade, sinnende su momentu in ue su primu aeroplanu aiat fertu s’obietivu suo.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Duos ràgios de lughe sunt istados aparitzados pro puntare fache a chelu a su note.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Su fràigu est in cursu pro chimbe iscarfachelos noos in su logu, cun unu tzentru de trasportu e unu parcu de sa memòria in mesu.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Su programa de sa PBS tenet prus de duas dosinas de prèmios Emmy e est a mancu petzi de Sesame Street e Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Cada episòdiu de su programa s’at a basare subra de unu tema in unu libru particulare e tando at a esplorare cussu tema cun istòrias mùltiplas.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Cada programa at a sugerire finas libros chi sos pitzinnos diant dèvere chircare cando andant a sa libreria issoro.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, de WNED Buffalo (istatzione de Reading Rainbow) at naradu "Reading Rainbow at imparadu a sos pitzinnos proite lèghere,... s’amore pro sa letura — [su programa] at incoragidu sos pitzinnos a pigare unu libru e a lèghere."
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Calicunu, comente a John Grant, pessat chi, siat sa crisi de sos finantziamentos siat su cambiamentu de filosofia in sa programatzione educativa televisiva, ant contribuidu a fàghere agabare sa sèrie.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Sa traschia, a 645 mìglios (1040 km) a ovest de sas ìsulas de Cabu Birde, si diat dèpere ispèrdere in antis de minetzare sas àreas de terra, a cantu narant sas previsiones de su tempus.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Pro como Fred tenet bentos de 105 mìglios a s’ora (165 km/h) e est tramudende conca a nordovest.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred est su tziclone tropicale prus forte mai registradu finas a como in su sud e s’est de s’Atlànticu dae sa lòmpida de sas imàgines de satèllite, e isceti su de tres uraganos prus mannos registrados in s’est de 35°W.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Su 24 de Cabudanni de su 1759, Arthur Guinness at firmadu un’afitu de 9000 annos pro su Birrifìtziu St James’ Gate in Dublinu, Irlanda.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: A pustis de 250 annos, Guinness est crèschida finas a èssere un’impresa globale chi faturat 10 miliardos de èuros (14.7 miliardo US$) cada annu.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, co-pilota de s’iscuadra de sa Noa Zelanda A1GP, oe at fatu s’istòria ghiende a sa velotzidade màssima in su ponte de 48 annos Auckland Harbour Bridge, Noa Zelanda, in manera legale.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Reid est resèssidu a ghiare sa vetura de A1GP de sa Noa Zelanda, Black Beauty, a sa velotzidade de 160 km/h sete bortas subra su ponte.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Sa politzia de sa Noa Zelanda at tentu dificultades impreende su radar de velotzidade pro bìdere cantu lestru Reid fiat andende, pro more de canto est bassa Black Beauty, e s’ùnica borta chi sa politzia est resèssida a registrare Reid est istada cando at allentadu a 160 km/h.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: In sos ùltimos 3 meses,prus de 80 pessones arrestadas sunt istadas lassadas in libertade dae s’istrutura de Central Booking sena peruna acusa formale.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Ocannu in Abrile un’òrdine de restritzione temporale fiat istadu emìtidu dae su giuighe, Glynn contra s’istrutura pro fortzare sa liberatzione de cussas pessones tentas prus de 24 oras a pustis de s’intrada issoro chi no aiant retzidu peruna udièntzia dae sa corte.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Su commissàriu istabilit sa cautzione, si est cuntzèdida, e formalizat sas acusas archiviadas dae s’ofitziale de s’arrestu. Sas acusas tando sunt postas in intro de su sistema informàticu istatale, in ue si sighet su casu.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: S’udièntzia sinnat puru sa data pro su deretu de sa pessone suspetada a unu protzessu lestru.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, ministru de sas finàntzias de Austràlia e s’òmine prus probàbile pro sustituire su Primu Ministru John Howard comente capu de su partidu Liberale at dadu su suportu a s’industria nucleare in Austràlia.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Costello at naradu chi cando sa generatzione de energia nucleare est cumbeniosa pro s’economia, s’Austràlia diat dèpere sighire s’impreu suo.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: “Si divennet cummertziale, la diamus dèpere tènnere. Overas, non b’at pregiudìtzios contra s’energia nucleare” at naradu Costello.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Segundu s’Ansa, “sa politzia fiat preocupada pro una pariga de corpos de livellu màssimu, chi timiant chi podiant cumintzare una bera gherra de sutzessione.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Sa politzia at naradu chi Lo Piccolo at tentu una positzione de avantàgiu, ca fiat istadu su bratzu deretu de Provenzano in Palermo e cun s’esperièntzia sua prus manna aiat concuistadu su respetu de sa generatzione prus betza de capos, ca issos sighiant sa lìnia de Provenzano de mantènnere unu profilu bassu e in su mentras afortiare sa rete de podere.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Custos capos fiant istados incarrigados dae Provenzano cando issu aiat postu fine a sa gherra ghiada dae Riina contra s’istadu, chi nd’aiat tiradu sa vida a sos eroes contra sa Màfia Giovanni Falcone e Paolo Borsellino in su 1992.”
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Su CEO de Apple Steve Jobs at isveladu su dispositivu pesende·nche a su palcu e boghende s’iPhone dae sa butzaca de sos jeans.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Durante su discursu sou de duas oras, at afirmadu chi “Oe Apple est torrende a inventare su telèfonu, Oe semus faghende s’istòria”.
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Su Brasile est su paisu Catòlicu Romanu prùs mànnu in sa Terra, e sa Crèsia Catòlica Romana at refudadu in manera regulare sa legalizatzione in su paisu de sa coja intre sas pessones de su matessi sessu.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Su Cungressu Natzionale de Brasile at discùtidu sa legalizatzione pro 10 annos, e custas cojas tziviles a oe sunt legales isceti in Rio Grande do Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Sa proposta originale fiat istada preparada dae sa sìndiga betza de São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. Sa leze proposta, a pustis de èssere emendada, como est in sas manos de Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Sos manifestantes isperant de regòllere una petitzione de 1.2 miliones de firmas de presentare a su Cungressu Natzionale in Santandria.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: A pustis de divènnere craru chi medas famìlias fiant chirchende agiudu legale pro cumbàtere sos isfratos, est istadu fatu un’addòbiu pro sas vìtimas de trampas immobiliares, su 20 de Martzu in su East Bay Community Law Center.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Cando sos incuilinos ant cumintzadu a cumpartzire su chi lis fia acuntessende, sa parte manna de sas famìlias interessadas at cumprèndidu deretu chi Carloyn Wilson de sa OHA lis aiat furadu sos depòsitos de seguresa e si nde fiat fuida dae sa tzitade.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Sos incuilinos de sos Lockwood Gardens creent chi bi podent èssere àteras 40 famìlias o prus cumbatende sos isfratos, ca ant ischidu chi sa politzia OHA est faghende un’indàgine subra de àteras propiedades immobiliares pùblicas in Oakland chi diant pòdere èssere trisinadas in sas trampas.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Su grupu at cantzelladu s’ispetàculu in su Maui War Memorial Stadium, chi fiat istadu preparadu pro retzire 9000 pessones, e s’est iscusadu cun sos sighidores.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Sa cumpangia de gestione de su grupu, HK Management Inc., a su cumintzu no aiat dadu resones cando aiant cantzelladu su 20 de Cabudanni, ma at indiTadu resones logìsticas pro sa die in fatu.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Sos abogados famados de sa Grètzia, Sakis Kechagioglou e George Nikolakopoulos, sunt istados batidos in sa presone de Atene de Korydallus, ca sunt istados agatados faltosos de tangentes e corrutzione.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Comente cunsighèntzia de custu, est istadu pesadu un’iscàndalu mannu in intro de sa comunidade legale greca, cun sa mustra de sas atziones illegales chi giughes, abogados, procuradores e pùblicos ministeros aiant fatu in sos annos pretzedentes.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Carchi chida a oe, a pustis de sa noa publicada dae su giornalista Makis Triantafylopoulos in su programma de televisione populare sou “Zoungla” in Alpha TV, su membru de su Parlamentu e abogadu, Petros Mantouvalos aiat renuntziadu, ca sos membros de s’ufìtziu sou fiant istados interessados in finantziamentos illegales e corrutzione.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: In prus, su giughe capu Evangelos Kalousis est in presone ca l’ant agatadu faltosu de corrutzione e conduta degenerada.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts at refudadu in manera assoluta de chistionare de cando issu creet chi sa vida cumintzat, una chistione de importu cunsiderende s’ètica de s’aurtida, narende chi non diat èssere èticu cummentare sas ispetzifitzidades de casos probàbiles.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: At repìtidu, de cada manera, sa decraratzione fata in antis chi Roe v. Wade fiat “sa lege istabilida de sa zona”, ponende ènfasi in s’importu de sas detzisiones coerentes de sa Corte Suprema.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: At cunfirmadu puru chi creet in su deretu implìtzitu a sa riservadesa, dae cale est dipèndida sa detzisione de Roe.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore at agabbadu pro primu in sa classìfica, cun ses puntos in prus de Noos, segundu.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Sas duas partes aiant giogadu in sa semifinale in ue Noosa aiat pèrdidu de 11 puntos.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore tando at bintu contra Caboolture in sa finale preliminare.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae est una genia de sa famìglia Dromaeosauridae e est unu fradile de Velociraptor .
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Custu pillone aggarradore totu cobertu de pinnas e a sàmbene callente si pensat ca caminat stantàrgiu cun duas cambas e cun farrancas comente su Velociraptor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Sa segunda farranca fiat prus manna, dende logu a su nùmene Hesperonychus, chi bolet nàrrere “farranca otzidentale”.
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: In agiunta a sa segada de s’astrau, sas conditziones estremas de su tempus ant fatu prus difìtziles sos traballos de recùperu.

text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: B’at sa preocupatzione chi sos patzientes potzant sighire a infetare prus pessones sighende sas atividades de cada die si sos sìntomos de s’influèntzia abarrant lèbios.
text_en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Leslie Aun, portaboghe de sa Komen Foundation, at naradu chi s’organizatzione at adotadu una règula noa chi non permitit de assignare bursas o finantziamentos a organizatziones chi sunt suta indàgine legale.
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: Sa polìtica de Komen at esclùdidu Planned Parenthood pro more de un’indàgine pendente subra de comente s’organizatzione ispendet e torrat su contu de su dinare, ghiada dae su delegadu Cliff Stearns.
text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Stearns est indaghende si sas impostas sunt impreadas pro finatziare abortos tràmite Planned Parenthood, in sa positzione de presidente de sa Supervisione e Subcommissàriu de sas Indàgines, suta sa gestione de su Comitadu de s’Energia e su Cummèrtziu de sa Càmera.
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: S’ex guvernadore de su Massachussetts Mitt Romney custu martis at bintu sas eletziones primàrias de su Partidu Republicanu de sa Flòrida cun prus de su 46 pro chentu de sos votos.
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: S’ex presidente de sa Càmera Newt Gingrich est arribadu segundu cun su 32 pro chentu.
text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Dae chi su binchidore pigat totu s’Istadu, sa Flòrida at assignadu totu sos chimbanta delegados suos a Romney, ispinghende·lu comente su candidadu majore pro sa nòmina de su Partidu Republicanu.
text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Sos organizadores de sa protesta ant naradu chi 100.000 pessones sunt lòmpidas in tzitades de Germània comente Berlinu, Colònia, Amburgu e Hannover.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: In Berlinu, sa politzia at calculadu 6.500 manifestantes.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Protestas bi sunt istadas finas in Parigi, in Sofia (Bulgaria), in Vìlnius (Lituània), in Valletta (Malta), in Tallinn (Estònia) e Edinburgu e Glasgow in Iscòtzia.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: In Londra pagu prus a mancu 200 pessones ant protestadu in foras de sos ufìtzios de carchi mere de su copyright.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Su mese coladu, bi sunt istadas protestas importantes in Polònia cando sa natzione at firmadu s’ACTA, chi at batidu su guvernu polacu a detzìdere pro como de non ratificare s’acordu.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Letònia e Islovàchia ant ambas rinviadu s’adesione a s’ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Animal Liberation e sa Sotziedade Reale pro sa Preventzione de sa Crueldade contra sos Animales (RSPCA) sunt ancora pedende s’installatzione obligatoria de càmeras CCTV in totu sos bochidòrgios australianos.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Su capu ispetore de sa RSPCA de su Galles Nou de su Sud David O'Shannessy at naradu a ABC chi sa guardiania de sos mattatoju diat dèpere èssere normale in Austràlia.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: “Sas CCTV diant a imbiare de suguru unu sinnale forte a cussas persones chi traballant cun sos animales ca su benèssere issoro est sa prioridade màssima”.
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Sa mapa internatzionale de sos terremotos de su United States Geological Survey no at ammustradu terremotos in Islanda in sa chida innantis.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Fintzas s’Ufìtziu Meteriològicu Islandesu no at ammostau atividade sìsmica in sa zona de Hekla in sas ùrtimas 48 oras.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: S’atividadi sìsmica prus de importu chi at portau a su càmbiu de fasi est sutzèdia su 10 de Martzu in s’ala nord-est de su forreddu de pitzus de su vulcanu.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Funt istadas registradas nues nieddas chi no funt acapiadas cun atividade peruna de su vulcanu.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Sas nues no permitiant de cumprèndere bene chi fuit sutzessa un'erutzione o no’.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Su Luno teniat 120-160 mètros cùbicos de carburante in intro cando est rutu e sos bentos e sas undas l’ant ispintu subra de s’argine.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Sos elicòteros ant recuperadu sas dòighi pessones de s’iscuadra e s’ùnicu dannu est istadu unu nasu segadu.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Sa navia de 100 metros fiat andende a pigare su càrrigu usuale de fertilizadore e a su cumintzu sos ufitziales timiant chi s’imbarcatzione poderet pèrdere su càrrigu.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: S’emendamentu propostu aiat giai coladu sas duas càmeras in su 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Est istadu fatu unu càmbiu in custa sessione legislativa, cando sa segunda frase est istada cantzellada antis dae sa Càmera de sos Representantes e posca est colada in forma sìmile a su Senadu, custu lunis.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Sa cantzelladura de sa segunda frase, chi proponet de vedare sas uniones tziviles intre pessones de su matessi sessu, diat pòdere agiudare a sas uniones tzivile in su benidore.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: A pustis de su protzessu, HJR-3 at a èssere torrada a esaminare dae sa legislatura imbeniente in su 2015 o su 2016 pro abarrare in cursu.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Àteros resurtados de Vautier foras de sa regia includint un’isciòperu de su fàmene in su 1973 contras su chi issu aiat bidu comente una tzensura polìtica.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Sa lege de sa Frantza fiat cambiada. S’ativismu sou fiat torradu a cando teniat 15 annos e si fiat unidu a sa Resistèntzia Frantzesa durante sa Segunda gherra mundiale.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Aiat documentadu sa vida sua in unu libru de su 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: In sos annos 60 fiat torradu in s’Algeria indipendente dae pagu pro imparare Regia.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Su judoka giaponesu Hitoshi Saito, binchidore de duas medàllias olìmpicas de oru, est mortu a s’edade de 54 annos.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Sa càusa de sa morte est istada unu càntzeru a su canale interepàticu de su fele.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Est mortu in Osaka, su martis.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Comente ex campione Olìmpicu e Mundiale, Saito fiat su presidente de su comitadu de allenamentu All Japan Judo Federation, a su momentu de sa morte.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: A su mancu 100 pessones fiant a sa festa, pro tzelebrare su primu annu de isposòriu de una còpia chi si fiat cojuada s’annu coladu.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Un’eventu de anniversàriu formale fiat istadu programmadu pro un’àtera die, narant sos ufitziales.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Sa còpia si fiat cojuada in Texas un’annu a oe e fiat andada in Buffalo pro fàghere festa cun amigos e famìllia.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Su pobiddu, de 30 annos, chi fiat nàschidu in Buffalo, est una de sas bator vìtimas de sos isparos, ma sa pobidda no est istada ferta.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno est unu maistru de inglesu connotu meda ma cuntrastadu, chi at imparadu cun Modern Education e King’s Glory e chi aiat afirmadu de tènnere 9.000 istudiantes a su màssimu de sa carriera.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: In sos apuntos, impreaiat faeddos chi carchi genitore cunsideraiat vulgares, e a cantu si narat, in classe impreaiat frastimos puru.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education l’at acusadu de àere imprentadu annùntzios mannos in sos postales sena permissu e de àere contadu fàulas narende de èssere su maistru capu de inglesu.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Fiat istadu acusadu puru de no àere respetadu sos deretos de autoria, ma no fiat istadu incriminadu.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un’istudiante at naradu chi impreaiat gergu in sas letziones, imparaiat tècnicas pro sos apuntamentos, e fiat comente s’amigu de sos istudiantes”.
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Durante sos ùltimos trinta annos, mancari siat abarrada in forma ufitziale un’istadu comunista, sa Tzina aiat isvilupadu un’economia de mercadu.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Sas primas reformas econòmicas sunt istadas fatas suta sa ghia de Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Dae tando, sa mannària econòmica de sa Tzina est crèschida de 90 bortas.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Pro sa prima borta, s’annu coladu sa Tzina at esportadu prus veturas de sa Germània e passadu sos Istados Unidos comente su mercadu prus mannu pro custa indùstria.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Su PIL de sa Tzina diat pòdere èssere prus mannu de cussu de sos Istados Unidos intro de binti annos.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: S’istrachia tropicale Danielle, sa de bator istrachias numenadas de s’istagione atlàntica 2010 de sos uraganos, s’est formada in s’est de s’Oceanu Atlànticu.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: S’istrachia, posta a 3.000 mìglios dae Miami, Flòrida, tenet bentos de velotzidade màssima de 40 mph (64kph).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Sos iscientziados de su Tzentru Natzionale de sos Uraganos previdint chi Danielle s’at afortiare a uraganu intro de mèrcuris.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Dae chi s’istrachia est ancora a tesu dae sa terra, est difìtzile a valutare s’efetu potentziale pro sos Istados Unidos o sos Caràibes.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Nàschidu in sa capitale de Croàtzia, Zagàbria, Bobek est devènnidu famadu cando giogaiat in su Partizan Belgrado.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Fiat arribadu in su 1945 e abarradu finas a su 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: In su tempus cun s’iscuadra, aiat marcadu 403 gol in 468 partidas.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Nemos at mai fatu prus partidas o gol de Bobek pro s’iscuadra.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: In su 1995 fiat istadu votadu comente su mègius giogadore de s’istòria de su Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Sas tzelebratziones sunt cumintzadas cun un’ispetàculu ispetziale de su grupu famadu in totu su mundu de su Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Est istadu sighidu dae s’Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, una banda giannìtzera e sos cantadores Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Posca sos Whirling Dervishes sunt pesados a su palcu.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Sa diva turca Sezen Aksu at cantadu cun su tenore italianu Alessandro Safina e su cantadore grecu Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Pro agabbare, su grupu de ballu turcu Fire of Anatolia ant presentadu s’ispetàculu “Troy”.
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, unu curridore de motocicleta de 13 annos, est mortu a pustis de su fragassu in su Tzircùidu de Indianapolis.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Durante su giru de callentamentu, Lenz nch’est rutu dae sa motocicleta e est istadu fertu dae su collega de cursa Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Est istadu assistidu deretu dae su personale mèdicu de sa cursa e tramudadu a un’ispidale de su logu, in ue est mortu a pustis.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat no est abarradu ingortu in s’intzidente.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Subra de sa situatzione finantziària globale, Zapatero at sighidu narende chi “su sistema finantziàriu est parte de s’economia, una parte detzisiva.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Tenimus una crisi finantziària dae un’annu, chi at tentu su momentu prus difìtzile in sos duos meses colados, e penso chi immoe sos mercados finantziàrios sunt cumintzende a recuperare.”
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Chida colada, Naked News at annuntziadu chi diat àere crèschidu de meda a beru su mandadu internatzionale de limbas pro sas noas, cun tres trasmissiones noas.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: S’organizatzione globale, chi giai faghet noas in inglesu e giaponesu, est cumintzende cun programmas in ispagnolu, italianu e coreanu, pro sa televisione, ìnternet e dispositivos mòbiles.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Pro fortuna non m’est sutzèdidu nudda, ma apo bidu un’iscena mala a beru, cun sa gente proende a arrogare sas ventanas pro nde essire.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Sa gente fiat iscudende sos bidros cun cadiras, ma sas ventanas fiant impossìbiles a segare.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “Unu de sos bidros a sa fine s’est segadu, e ant cumintzadu a nde essire dae sa ventana,” at naradu Franciszek Kowal, subrabìvidu.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Sas isteddas emitent lughe e calore gràtzias a s’energia formada cando sos àtomos de idrògeno s’ammesturant (o si fundent) a pare pro formare elementos prus graes.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Sos iscientziados sunt traballende pro creare unu reatore chi potzat fàghere energia in sa matessi manera.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Custu, de cada manera, est unu problema mannu de risòlvere e ant a serbire medas annos in antis de pòdere bìdere reatores de fusione funtzionantes.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: S’agu de aciàrgiu gallègiat in sa superfìtzie de s’abba pro sa tensione.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Sa tensione de superfìtzie si format ca sas molècolas de s’abba in artu s’atraent a pare a forte, prus de canto faghent cun sas molècolas de ària subra de cussas.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Sas molècolas de abba formant una pedde invisìbile in sa superfìtzie chi permitit, pro esempru, a s’agu de gallegiare.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Sa lama in unu pàtinu de astrau modernu tenet un’oru dòpiu cun un’istampu bòidu in mesu. Sos oros permitint unu cuntatu prus forte cun s’astrau, puru cando no est paris.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Sigomente sa fine de sa lama est unu pagu curva, cando sa lama fùrriat a un’ala o a s’àtera, puru s’oru chi est in cuntatu cun s’astrau faghet sa curva.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Custu permitit a su pàtinu de furriare. Si su pàtinu s’inclinat a sa dereta, su patinadore fùrriat a sa dereta, si su pàtinu s’inclinat a manca, su patinadore fùrriat a manca.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pro torrare a su livellu de energia de in antis, si depent liberare dae s’energia extra chi ant otentu dae sa lughe.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Lu faghent cun s’emissione de una partighedda pitica de lughe, numenada “fotone”.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Sos iscientziados li narant a custu protzessu “emissione istimulada de radiatzione”, ca sos àtomos sunt istimulados dae sa lughe forte, causende s’emissione de unu fotone de lughe, e sa lughe est una genia de radiatzione.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Sa figura imbeniente mustrat sos àtomos chi emitint fotones. Tzertu, in sa realidade sos fotones sunt meda prus piticos a beru che a cussos in sa figura.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Sos fotones sunt prus piticos ancora de sa matèria chi cumponet sos àtomos!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: A pustis de oras de operatzione su filamentu in sa lampadina a sa fine brùsiat e sa lughe non funtzionat prus.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Sa lampadina tando cheret cambiada. Tocat de fàghere atentzione meda cambiende·la.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Pro primu cosa, pro cambiare sa lampadina tocat de istudare sa currente o iscollegare su cavu.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Custu est ca sa currente chi colat in sa presa in ue est posta sa parte metàllica de sa lampadina, ti podet dare un’iscossa elètrica forte meda, si tocas sa parte de intro de sa presa o sa base metàllica de sa lampadina cando est ancora in intro.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: S’òrganu prus mannu de su sistema tzirculatòriu est su coro, chi ispinghet su sàmbene.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Su sàmbene moet dae su coro in vasos numenados artèrias e torrat a su coro in vasos numenados venas. Sos vasos prus piticos sunt numenados capillares.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Una dente de tritzeràtopu diat pòdere èssere capassa non de truncare fògias ebbia ma fintzas ramos e raighinas.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Carchi sientziadu pensat chi su Tritzeràtopu mandigaiat sas tzìcadofitas, chi sunt una genia de prantas comunes in su Cretàtzeu.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Custas prantas simìgiant a un’arboreddu de prama cun una corona de fògias puntudas.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Unu tritzeràtopu diat àere pòdidu usare su bicu forte chi giughet pro ispilire sas fògias in antis de si nche mandigare su truncu.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Àteros sientziados sunt de su parre chi custas prantas sunt velenosas meda, pro cussu, est difìtzile chi carchi dinosàuru las àeret mandigadas, mancari oe su bràdipu e àteros animales che a su papagallu (unu discendente de sos dinosàuros) potzant mandigare fògias velenosas o frùtora.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Cantu mi diat a atirare sa gravidade de Io? Si nch’èsseres in sa superfìtzie de Io, dias pesare prus pagu chi no in sa Terra.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Una persone chi pesat 200 libras (90kg) in sa Terra diat pesare pagu prus o mancu 36 libras (16kg) in Io. Duncas sa gravidade est òviu chi t’atirat prus pagu.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Sa crosta de su Sole no est comente a sa de sa terra chi bi podes istare a sa ritza. Su Sole est fatu totu de gas, fogu e plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Su gas si faghet prus sutile comente andas istesiende·ti dae su tzentru de su Sole.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Sa parte prus in fora chi bidimus cando pompiamus su sole si narat fotosfera, chi cheret nàrrere “botza de lughe”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Belle tres mìgia annos a pustis, in su 1610, s’astrònomu italianu Galileo Galilei aiat impreadu unu telescòpiu pro abbaidare chi Vènere est a fases, comente a sa luna etotu.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Sas fases acuntessent ca petzi una banda de Venere (o de sa luna) cara a Sole est illuminada. Sas fases de Vènere cuncordaiant cun sa teoria de Copèrnicu chi sos pranetas girant a inghìriu de su Sole.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Tando, unos cantos annos a pustis in su 1639, un’astrònomu chi si naraiat Jeremiah Horrocks aiat abbaidadu unu trànsitu de Vènere.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: S’Inghilterra aiat isperimentadu unu tempus longu de paghe a pustis de sa reconchista de su Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Nointames in su 991 Ethelred fiat istadu afrontadu dae una flota vichinga prus manna de calesi siat àtera, dae cussa de Guthrum chentu annos in antis.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Custa flota fiat ghiada dae Olaf Trygvasson, unu norvegesu cun ambitziones de liberare sa natzione sua dae sa dominatzione danesa.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: A pustis de arrèschidas militares de su cumintzu, Ethereld fiat renèssidu a si pònnere de acòrdu cun Olaf, chi fiat torradu in Norvègia pro proare a conchistare su rennu sou cun sorte alterna.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Su Hangeul est s’ùnicu alfabetu imbentadu a posta pro s’usu pobulare de cada die. S’alfabetu l’ant imbentadu in su 1444 durante su regnu de su re Sejong (1418 - 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Su re Sejong fiat su de bator res de s’ereu de Joseon e unu de sos prus cunsiderados bene.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: A printzìpios s’alfabetu Hangeul l’aiat mutidu Hunmin Jeongeum, chi cheret nàrrere “sos sonos curretos pro s’imparu de su pòbulu”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: B’at teorias meda subra de comente est nàschidu su sànscritu. Una de custas est chi una tràmuda de arianos nche fiat mòvida dae s’otzidente finas a s’Ìndia giughende·nche cun issos sa limba issoro.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Su sànscritu est una limba antiga e si podet paragonare cun su latinu faeddadu in Europa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Su libru prus antigu mai connotu in su mundu fiat iscritu in sànscritu. A pustis de sa cumpilatzione de sas Upanishad, su sànscritu est isparidu petzi pro una chistione de gerarchia.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Su sànscritu est una limba cumplessa e rica meda, dae ue sunt nàschidas paritzas limbas indianas modernas, comente a su latinu chi at dadu orìgine a limbas europeas che a su frantzesu e s’ispagnolu.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Agabbada sa batalla de Fràntzia, sa Germània aiat cumintzadu a s’aprontare pro invàdere s’ìsula de Britànnia.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Sa Germània aiat postu a s’atacu su nùmene in còdighe “Operatzione Leone Marinu”. Su prus de sas armas pesantes e de sas fruniduras de s’Esèrtzitu Britànnicu nche fiant andadas pèrdidas in s’evacuatzione dae Dunkirk, pro cussu s’esèrtzitu fiat bastante dèbile.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ma sa Marina Reale fiat galu meda prus forte de sa Marina Tedesca (“Kriegsmarine”) e podiat àere distrùidu una flota de invasione imbiada dae su Canale de sa Mànica.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: In cada manera, pagos pagos navios de sa Marina Reale nche fiant ancorados a curtzu de sas rotas de invasione probàbiles, dae chi sos ammiràllios fiant timende chi carchi atacu aèreu tedescu los èsseret afundados.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Cumintzamus ispieghende sos disinnos de s’Itàlia. S’Itàlia fiat prus che àteru sa “sorrighedda” de sa Germànià e de su Giapone.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Teniat un’esèrtzitu e una marina prus dèbiles, mancari aiant apenas fraigadu bator navios noos in antis de cumintzare sa gherra.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Sos obietivos printzipales de s’Itàlia fiant sos paisos africanos. Pro conchistare cuddos paisos, lis diat àere bisongiadu de tènnere una base de lantzu pro sas tropas, gasi chi sas tropas diant àere pòdidu navigare in su Mare Mediterràneu e invàdere s’Àfrica.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pro cussu, nche depiant catzare sas bases e sos navios britànnicos dae s’Egitu. A bandas de cussas atziones, sos navios de gherra de s’Itàlia non si suponiat chi aerent fatu àteru.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Como su Giapone. Su Giapone est un’ìsula, che a sa Britànnia etotu.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Sos sutamarinos sunt navios disinnados pro biagiare suta de s’abba, e pro b’abbarrare pro unu tempus longu.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Sos sutamarinos s’impreaiant in sa Prima e in sa Segunda gherra mundiale. In cuddu tempus fiant lentos meda e pagu potentes in sa ghetada de tiru.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: A su cumintzu de sa gherra biazaiant mescamente is su pìgiu de su mare, ma dae chi sos radar aiant cumintzadu a los iscobèrrere e a èssere prus pretzisos sos sutamarinos fiant obligados a si nche andare a suta de s’abba pro evitare chi los esserent bidos.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Sos sutamarinos tedescos si naraiant U-Boats. Sos tedescos fiant bonos a beru a navigare e a manigiare sos sutamarinos issoro.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Gràtzias a su sutzessu issoro cun sos sutamarinos, a pustis de sa gherra non b’aiat de si fidare chi sos tedescos nd’aerent tènnidu medas.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Emmo! Su re Tutankhamun, a bias naradu “Re Tut” o “Su re pitzocu”, est unu de sos prus famados soberanos de s’Egitu antigu in die de oe.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Sa cosa curiosa est chi non fiat cunsideradu de importu mannu in tempos antigos e non nche fiat registradu in sa majoria de sas listas de sos res antigos.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: In cada manera, s’iscoberta de sa tumba sua in su 1922 l’at resu una tzelebridade. Cando medas tumbas de su passadu las aiant isrobadas, sa sua in teoria l’aiant lassada chieta.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Sa majoria de sos ogetos interrados cun Tutankhamun si sunt cunservados bene, contende mìgias de artefatos fatos de metallos pretziosos e pedras raras.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: S’imbentu de sas rodas a rajos at fatu sos carros Assiros prus lèbios, lestros e bene ammaniados pro nche superare a soldados e àteros carros.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Sas fritzas de sas balestras mortales issoro si nche podiant fichire in s’armadura de sos soldados nemigos. Pagu prus o mancu de su 1000 in antis de Cristu, sos Assiros aiant introduidu sa prima cavalleria.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Una cavalleria est un’armada chi cumbatet a gropa de caddu. Sa sedda fiat galu a imbentare, e pro cussu sos cadderis assiros gherraiant in gropa a sas ischinas nudas de sos caddos issoro.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Connoschimus a medas polìticos gregos, sientziados e artistas. Est possìbile chi sa persone prus connota de custa cultura siat Omeru, su poeta tzegu legendàriu, chi aiat cumpostu duas òperas de primore de sa literatura grega: sos poemas Iliade e Odissea.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sòfocle e Aristòfane sunt iscritores de òperas teatrales galu nòdidos e sas cummèdias issoro sunt cunsideradas de sas de majore importu intre sas òperas de sa literatura mundiale.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Un’àteru Gregu famosu est su matemàticu Pitàgora, pro su prus connotu pro su teorema suo famadu in contu de sa relata intre sos lados de su triàngulu retàngulu.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Càmbiant sas istimas subra de comente medas persones faeddant su Hindi. S’istimat chi siat intre sa segunda e sa de bator limbas prus a fitianu faeddadas in su mundu.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Su nùmeru de faeddadores nativos càmbiat cunforma a si tenet in contu si su ligàmene intre sos dialetusu est istrintu meda o nono.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Istimat un’intervallu dae 340 a 500 miliones de faeddadores, e finas a unu tantu de 800 miliones de persones cumprendent sa limba.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi e Urdu sunt simigiantes in su vacabolàriu ma diferentes in s’iscritura; in sa faeddada fitiana, sos faeddadores de ambas sas limbas a su sòlitu si cumprèndent s’unu cun s’àtera.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: A inghìriu de su de 15 sèculos, su nord de s’Estònia fiat meda suta de s’influèntzia de sa Germània.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Carchi mòngiu tedescu aiat chèrfidu acurtziare a Deus a sos nadivos, pro cussu aiant imbentadu sa limba literale èstone.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Fiat basadu subra de s’alfabetu tedescu cun s’annanta de su caràtere "Õ/õ" .
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Colende su tempus, medas paràulas pigadas in prèstidu dae su tedescu si sunt unidas. Custu est istadu su cumintzu de s’illuminatzione.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: A su connotu, s’erede a su tronu diat intrare deretu a s’esèrtzitu cando nche finiat s’iscola.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: In cada manera, Càralu fiat andadu a s’universidade a su Trinity College, in Cambridge aiat istudiadu antropologia e archeologia e prus a tardu istòria, otenende unu 2:2 (unu tìtulu de segunda classe inferiore).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Càralu fiat su primu membru de sa Famìlia Reale Britànnica a pigare unu tìtulu.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Sa Turchia europea (sa Tràcia orientale o Rumelia in sa penìsula balcànica) incluet su 3% de su paisu.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Su territòriu de sa Turchia est de prus de 1600 chilòmetros (1000 mi) de longària e de 800 km (500 mi) de ampresa, cun una forma casi retangulare.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: S’àrea de sa Turchia, contende sos lagos, òcupat 783.562 chilòmetros cuadrados (300,948 sq mi), chi 755.688 chilòmetros cuadrados (291,773 sq mi) sunt in s’Àsia sud-otzidentale e 23,764 chilòmetros cuadrados (9,174 sq mi) in s’Europa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Sa superfìtzie de sa Turchia faghet chi siat su de 37 paisos prus mannos de su mundu, e est belle cantu a sa mannària de sa Frantza metropolitana e de su Regnu Unidu paris.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Sa Turchia est inghiriada dae su mare dae tres chirrus: dae su Mare Egeu dae otzidente, dae su Mare Nieddu dae susu e dae su Mare Mediterràneu dae josso.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Su Lussemburgu tenet un’istòria longa ma sa data de s’indipendèntzia sua est su 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Sas partes chi oe sunt de su Bèlgiu in antis faghiant parte de su Lussemburgu ma sunt coladas a su Bèlgiu a pustis de sa Rivolutzione belga de su 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Su Lussemburgu at semper proadu a abarrare unu paisu neutrale ma sa Germània l’at ocupadu siat in sa Prima siat in sa Segunda gherra mundiale.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: In su 1957 su Lussemburgu est divènnidu unu paisu membru fundadore de s’organizatzione chi oe est connota comente s’Unione Europea.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Su Drukgyal Dzong est unu forte derrutu e monastèriu buddista in s’ala prus a susu de su distretu de Paro (in su bidditzolu de Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Si narat chi in su 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel nch’at fraigadu su fortesa in ammentu de sa vittòria sua contra sas fortzas Tibetanas-Mòngolas.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: In su 1951, dae unu fogu b’at abarradu petzi unas cantas relìchias de su Drukgyal Dzong, comente a s’imàgine de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: A pustis de su fogu, su forte s’est cunservadu e amparadu, abarrende unu de sas atratziones prus ispantosas de su Buthan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Durante su de 18 sèculos sa Cambògia s’est agatada isprèmida intre duos bighinos potentes, sa Tailàndia e su Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Sos Thai ant invàdidu sa Cambògia paritzas bortas in su de 18 sèculos e in su 1772 ant distrùidu Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: In sos ùrtimos annos de su de 18 sèculos sos vietnamitas ant invàdidu puru sa Cambògia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Su degheoto pro chentu de sos venetzuelanos sunt disocupados, e su prus de sos ocupados traballant in s’economia informale.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Duos tertzos de sos venetzuelanos chi traballant lu faghent in su settore de sos servìtzius, tzirca su de battor unu traballat in s’indùstria e su de chimbe unu in sa massaria.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Un’indùstria de importu pro sos venetzuelanos est sa de su petròliu, ue su paisu est un’esportadore netu, sende chi petzi s’unu pro chentu traballat in s’industria de su petròliu.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: In su primu tempus de s’indipendèntzia natzionale, sa maestria de sos Giardinos botànicos de Singapore aiat agiudadu a trasformare s’ìsula in una Tzitade Giardinu tropicale.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: In su 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, un’orchidea ìbrida, est istada seberada comente frore natzionale de sa natzione.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Cada annu prus o mancu in Santugaine belle 1,5 milliones de erbìvoros tucant conca a sas campuras meridionales, giumpende su riu Mara, dae sos montigros setentrionales pro s’abba.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E luego torrant a palas conca a su nord dae otzidente, giumpende un’àtera borta su riu Mara, a pustis de sas abbas a inghìriu de Abrile.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Sa regione de Serengeti cuntenet su Parcu natzionale de Serengheti, s’àera amparada de Ngorongoro e sa riserva de catza in Tanzania e sa riserva natzionale Maasai Mara in Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Su de imparare a creare cuntenutos multimediales interativos rechedet abilidades cunventzionales e traditzionales, gasi comente ainas manigiadas in sas letziones interativas (s’ammàniu de tàulas narrativas, editzione de àudiu e vìdeu, contu de istòrias, etc.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Sa gràfica interativa rechedet chi torres a cunsiderare sos presupostos tuos in contu de produtzione de cuntenutos multimediales e impares a pensare in manera non-liniare.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Sa gràfica interativa cheret chi sos cumponentes de unu progetu si connetant s’unu cun s’àteru, ma chi tèngiant sentidu puru comente un’entidade seberada.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Su chi non batit profetu de sos obietivos zoom est chi sa cumplessidade focale e su nùmeru de elementos de s’obietivu netzessàrios pro otènnere una gama de longàrias focales est meda prus artu in cunfrontu a sos obietivos printzipale.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Custu est cumintzende a dare prus pagos problemas dae comente sos produtores de obietivos ant logradu istandard prus artos in sa produtzione de obietivos.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Custu at permìtidu a sos obietivos zoom de prodùere immàgines de una calidade chi si podet pònnere a paragone cun sa chi logrant sos obietivos de longària focale fissa.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Un’àteru disvantàgiu de sos obietivos zoom est chi s’abertura màssima (sa velotzidade) de sos obietivos a su sòlitu est prus bassa.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Custu faghet chi sos obietivos zoom baratos siant prus difìtziles de usare cando sa lughe est bassa chena su flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Unu de sos problemas prus comunes cando si cumbertidi una pellìcula in formatu DVD est sa subraiscansione.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Su prus de sas televisiones sunt fatas pro cuntentare su pùblicu generale.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Pro custu, totu su chi bides in sa televisione teniat sos oros segados in susu, in giosso e a sas bandas.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Custu est fatu pro assegurare chi s’immàgine coberat totu s’ischermu. A custu li narant subraiscansione.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: A dolu mannu, cando faghes unu DVD, est fàtzile chi sos oros si seghen issos puru, e si su vìdeu teniat sutatìtulos tropu acanta a su fundu, no s’ant a bìdere totus.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Su casteddu medievale traditzionale at ispiradu a longu s’immaginatzione, boghende a campu immàgines de giostras, de rebotas e de cabadderis de Artù.
