text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Fintzas abarrende in mesu de ruinas betzas de milli annos est fàtzile a s’ammentare de su sonu e de su fragu de peleas de unu tempus larganu, agiomai de intèndere tzocos de caddos in s’imperdadu e de pigare su fragu de timoria pesende·si dae sas presones suta de terra.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ma s’immaginatzione nostra basada subra de realidade est? Pro prima cosa, pro ite b’aiat casteddos fraigados? Comente aiant fatu a los disinnare e los pesare?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tìpicu de cuddu tempus, su casteddu de Kirby Muxloe est prus una domo fortificada chi non unu casteddu verdaderu.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Sas bidrieras mannas suas e sos muros finos non diant àere ischidu comente aguantare un’atacu tzèrrimu longu.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: In su 1480, cando Lord Hastins aiat cumintzadu a lu fraigare, su sartu fiat prus o mancu in paghe e fiat a lu difèndere petzi contra a trabellos de bardaneris errantes.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: S’echilìbriu de su podere fiat unu sistema ue sas natziones europeas chircaiant de mantènnere sa soberania natzionale in totu sos istados europeos.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Su cuntzetu fiat chi totu sas natziones euopeas depiant impedire a una natzione de si fàghere potente, e duncas sos poderes natzionales cambiaiant totora sas alleàntzias pro mantènnere s’echilìbriu.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Sa Gherra de Sutzessione Ispagnola at sinnadu sa prima gherra ue su tema tzentrale fiat s’echilìbriu de su podere.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Custu at sinnadu unu cambiamentu de importu, dae chi sas potèntzias europeas non diant àere àpidu prus s’iscusa pro b’àere gherras de religione. Tando, sa Gherra de sos trinta annos diat èssere s’ùrtima gherra etichetada comente gherra de religione.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Su tèmpiu de Artèmide in Èfesu l’ant destrùidu su 21 de Trìulas, 356 A.C. in unu fogu dolosu apicadu dae Eròstratu.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Segundu s’istòria, sa resone sua fiat sa fama a cada costu. Sos efesianos, ofèndidos, aiant annuntziadu chi su nùmene de Eròstratu mai diat èssere istadu ammentadu.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: S’istòricu gregu Strabone prus a tardu aiat anotadu su nùmene, chi est comente lu connoschimus oe. Su tèmpiu fiat distrùidu sa matessi note chi fiat nàschidu Lisandru Mannu.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Lisandru, comente re, si fiat ofertu de pagare sa recostrùida de su tèmpiu, ma s’oferta sua fiat istada refudada. Posca, a pustis de sa morte de Lisandru, su templu fiat istadu torradu a fraigare in su 323 in antis de Cristu.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Segura·ti chi sa manu tua siat su prus rilassada chi podes cando ses galu tochende totu sas notas in manera curreta - proa puru a non fàghere cun sos pòddighes medas mossas chi non b’intrant nudda.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: In custa manera, t’as a istragare su prus pagu possìbile. Ammenta chi non b’est su bisòngiu de incarcare sos tastos a forte meda pro artziare su volume comente in su pianoforte.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: In s’acordu, pro artziare su volume, imprea su fode cun prus pressione o velotzidade.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Su mistitzismu est sa chirca de comunione, identidade o cognitzione de una realidade, divinidade, veridade ispirituale ùrtima, o Deus.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Su fidele chircat una esperièntzia direta, intuitzione, o realidade a intro de sa realidade divina/sa divinidade o divinidades.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Sos sighidores sighent un’istile de bida pretzisu, o pràticas chi sunt cuntzepidas pro contivigiare cussas esperièntzias.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Su mistitzismu podet èssere distintu dae àteras formas de credèntzia religiosa e adoratzione cun s’enfasi sua pro s’esperièntzia personale direta de un’istadu de cussèntzia ùnicu, in particulare sa de caràtere patzìficu, profundu, biadu o mancari estasiàticu.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Su Sikhismu est una religione de su sub-continente indianu. S’est originada in su Punjab in su de 15 sèculos dae un’ispartidura intre setas de sa traditzione indù.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sos Sikh cunsìderant sa fide issoro una religione a banda dae s’induismu sende chi connoscant sa raighinas e sas traditziones issoro indù.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sos Sikh li narant a sa religione issoro gurmat, chi in punjabi est “sa bia de su guru”. Su guru est un’aspetu fundamentale de totu cantas sas religiones indianas ma in su Sikhismu at logradu un’importu chi est su coro de sas credèntzias de sos Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Sa religione est istada fundada in su de 15 sèculos dae su Guru Nanak (1469-1539). Si sunt sighidos in sa sutzessione àteros noe gurus.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: In cada manera, in Làmpadas de su 1956, sas promissas de Krushchev fiant istadas postas a proa cando sas rebellias in Polònia, ue sos traballadores fiant protestende contra a sa farta de màndigu e s’abbassada de sos salàrios, si fiat bortada in una protesta generale contra a su Comunismu.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Mancari a sa fine Krushchev aiat imbiadu carros armados pro ripristinare s’òrdine, aiat incaminadu unas cantas rechestas econòmicas e fiat de acordu cun sa posta de Wladyslaw Gomulka comente primu ministru nou.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Sa Tziviltade de sa Badde de s’Indo fiat una tziviltade de s’Edade de su brunzu in s’ala nord-otzidentale de su subcontinente indianu chi pigat su prus de su Pakistan de oe e carchi regione de s’Ìndia nord-otzidentale e de s’Afgànistan nord-orientale.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Sa tziviltade fiat frorida in sos batzinos de su riu Indo dae ue pigat su nùmene.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Mancari carchi acadèmicu nàrgiant pro ipòtesi chi dae su momentu chi èsseret esistida sa tziviltade in sos batzinos de su chi como est su riu sicadu Sarasvati, diat èssere giustu a la mutire tziviltade Indo-Sarasvati, cando calicunu la mutit sa tziviltade Harappana pro Harappa, su primu logu a èssere iscavadu in is annos 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Sa natura militarista de s’Imperu romanu aiat agiudadu in sa crèschida de sos avantzamentos mèdicos.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Sos dutores aiant cumitzadu a los reclutare s’imperadore Augustu e aiant formadu puru sos primos corpos mèigos romanos de impreare a pustis de sas batallas.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Sos chirurgos aiant sa connoschèntzia de vàrios sedativos includende sa morfina chi bogaiant dae sos sèmenes de tanda e iscopolamina dae sos sèmenes de s'erba.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Issos si fiant fatos profetosos in su de amputare pro sarvare sos patzientes cun cangrena gasi comente cun sos latzos emostàticos e morsetos pro sas artèrias pro tupponare su flussu de su sàmbene.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Pro sèculos meda, s’Imperu romanu at ghiadu a grandu conchistas in su campu de sa sièntzia mèiga e at dadu forma a meda de su connotu chi ischimus oe.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Sos origami de sa terra pura est s’origami chi si podet fàghere petzi una pìnniga a sa borta, pìnnigas prus cumplessas comente sas a su contràriu non sunt permìtidas, e totu sas pìnnigas tenent unu logu craru.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: L’aiat ammaniadu John Smith in su 1970 pro agiudare a sos pinnigadores pagu espertos o cun capatzidades motòrias limitadas.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Sos pitzinnos isvilupat unu seru de sa ratza e sos istereòtipos ratziales a giovanos e custos istereòtipos ratziales cunditzionant su cumportamentu.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Pro esempru, sos pitzinnos chi s'identìficant cun una minoria ratziale chi est istereotipada comente su de no andare bene in iscola pigant su ghetu de no andare bene in iscola una borta chi imparant chi est un'istereòtipu assotziadu cun sa ratza issoro.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace est su de tres situ prus populare impreadu in sos Istados Unidos e tenet a dies de oe 54 milliones de profilos.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Custos sitos ìnternet ant retzidu atentzione meda, prus che totu in su setore de s’istrutzione.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: B’at cosas positivas in custos sitos ìnternet, comente pòdere impostare in manera fàtzile una pàgina pro letziones, chi includet blog, vìdeos, fotografias e àteras funtziones.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: In custa pàgina si podet intrare frunende un’indiritzu ìnternet ebbia, prus fàtzile de regordare e de iscriere pro istudiantes chi tenent problemas in s’impreu de su tecladu o in s’iscritura.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Podet èssere personalizadu pro fàghere prus fàtzile a lèghere fintzas cun pagu o meda colore, comente disigiadu.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Su disturbu de farta de atentu “est una sìndrome neurològica chi sos tres sìntomos sunt sa fùria, su de si distàere e su de èssere tropu ativos o cun tropu energia”.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: No est de disabilidade de s’imparu, est unu disòrdine; custa “tocat su 3 de su 5 pro chentu de totu sos pitzinnos, fortzis fintzas a 2 milliones de pitzinnos americanos”.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: A sos pitzinnos cun su DDA lis costat meda a si cuntzentrare in cosas che a sas fainas de s’iscola, ma nch’essint a si cuntzentrare in cosas chi lis piaghent comente a giogare o a si pompiare sos cartones animados preferidos o a iscrìere fràsias chena puntegiadura.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Sos pitzinnos tenent su ghetu de si pònnere in problemas mannos, ca issos “ponent in atu cumportamentos periculosos, si ponent a brigare, e ponent fronte a sas autoridades” pro istimulare sa mente, dae chi sa mente issoro non l’istìmulant sos mètodos normales.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Sa DDA noghet a sas relatziones cun àteros cumpàngios ca non cumprendent proite si cumportant gasi o proite issos iscrìent su chi faghent o su livellu de maturidade issoro est diferente.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Dae chi s’abilidade de otènnere sa connoschèntzia e de imparare est cambiada in sa manera mentovada in antis su tassu base pro nche lòmpere a sa connoschèntzia est cambiadu.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Su ghetu pro otènnere informatziones fiat diferente. Sa pressione non fiat prus a intro de s’ammentu individuale, ma s’abilidade de torrare a cramare su testu diveniat prus de unu puntu focale.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: In pràtica, su Rinnaschimentu aiat batidu unu càmbiu de importu in sa manera de imparare e ispainare su connotu.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: A diferèntzia de sos primates, sos omìnides no impreaiant prus sas manos pro caminare o pro carrare pesos o pro bantzigare intre sos àrvores.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Sos pedes e sas manos de sos iscimpanzè sunt sìmiles in sa mannària e longària, rifletende s’usu de sas manos pro carrare pesos caminende in sas nujas.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Sa manu umana est prus curtza de su pede, cun sos ossos de sos pòddighes prus deretos.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Sos ossos fòssiles de sa manu betzos dae duos a tres milliones de annos ammustrant custu càmbiu in s’ispetzializatzione de sa manu dae sa caminada a su manìgiu.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Carchi persone creet chi esperientziare medas bisos lùghidos batidos in manera artifitziale a s'ispissu podet istracare meda.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Sa resone printzipale de custu fenòmenu est su resurtadu de sos bisos lùghidos chi creschent sa longària de su tempus intre sas fases REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Cun prus pagas REM a note, custu istadu ue faghes s’esperièntzia de su sonnu etotu e su corpus tuo recùperat divenit bastante pagu fitianu pro divènnere unu problema.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Custu istracat giustu comente si tue èsseret ischida cada binti o trinta minutos e pòmpias sa TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: S’efetu dipendet dae cantu ispissu su cherveddu tuo proat a sonniare de manera lùghida a note.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Sas cosas non sunt andadas bene pro sos Italianos in Nord Àfrica belle dae su cumintzu. A intro de una chida dae sa decraratzione de gherra de s’Itàlia de su 10 de Làmpadas 1940, su de 11 Regimentu Ùssaros Britànnicu aiat apoderadu Forte Capuzzo in Lìbia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: In un’apostada a est de Bàrdia, sos Britànnicos aiant cassadu su Generale Lastucci, cumandante zenieri de sa dètzima armada de s’esèrtzitu italianu.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Su 28 de su Mese de Làmpadas, su maresciallu Ìtalu Balbo, Guvernadore de sa Lìbia e erederi deretu de Mussolini, fiat istadu bochidu dae fogu amigu cando fiat arrivende in Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: S’isport modernu de s’ischerma est giogadu a medas livellos, dae sos istudiantes chi l’imparant a s’universidade a sos professionistas e sas cumpetitziones olìmpicas.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: S’isport est giogadu prus che totu in forma de duellu, cun unu tirende de ischerma contras a un’àteru.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Su golf est un’isport in ue sos giogadores impreant matzas pro lantzare bòcias in istampos.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Durante una partida regulare, si giogant degheotu istampos, cun sos giogadores chi de sòlitu cumintzant in su primu istampu de sa cursa e agabbant in su de degheotu.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Su giogadore chi faghet prus pagu corpos, o càmbios de matza, pro cumpletare sa cursa, binchet.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Sa partida si giogat in s’erba, e s’erba a fùrriu de s’istampu est segada prus a curtzu e li narant green.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Forsis sa genia de turismu prus comune est cussa chi sa zente assòtziat a su biazu: su turismu de tempus lìberu.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Custu est cando sa zente andat in unu logu chi est diferente meda dae sa vida regulare de cada die pro pausare e s’ispassiare.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Plajas, parcos a tema e campègios sunt a s’ispissu sos logos prus comunes in ue andant sos turistas pro su tempus lìberu.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Si s’obietivu de sa bìsita in unu logu ispetzìficu est de connòschere s’istòria e sa cultura sua, tando custa genia de turismu est connota comente turismu culturale.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Sos turistas podent visitare monumentos diferentes de un’istadu ispetzìficu o podent seberare simpremente de si cuntzentrare in un’àrea ebbia.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Sos terrales puru, bidende custa atividade, aiant cramadu a refortzos.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Sas tropas chi refortzaiant sas positziones prus in antis includiant su 1° e su 3° regimentu de su New Hampshire de 200 òmines, suta sos Colonnellos John Stark e James Reed (chi a pustis sunt divènnidos generales).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Sos òmines de Stark aiant pigadu positzione in sa barrera in s’ala nord de sa positzione de sos terrales.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Cando sa marea bassa aiat abertu un’ispàtziu oru oru de su Mystic River in su nordest de sa penìsula, aiant istèrridu a lestru sa barrera cun unu muru de perda curtzu in s’ala nord a s’oru de mare in una plaja pitica.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley o Stark aiant prantadu unu palu de prus o mancu 100 pees (30 metros) in antis de sa barrera e ordinadu chi nemos ispararet finas a cando sos regulares esserent passados.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Su pianu americanu puntaiat a lantzare atacos coordinados dae tres positziones diferentes.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Su generale Hohn Cadwalder diat àere lantzadu un’atacu contras su presìdiu britànnicu in Bordertown pro lu distràere, pro blocare cale si siat refortzu.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Su generale James Erving diat àere pigadu 700 milìtzias oru oru de su riu in Trenton Ferry, pigadu possessu de su ponte in Assunpink Creek e evitadu a sas tropas nemigas de si nde fuire.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Sa fortza de assaltu printzipale de 2400 òmines diat àere atraessadu su riu noe mìglios a nord de Trenton, e posca si diat èssere partzida in duos grupos, unu suta Greene e unu suta Sullivan, pro lantzare un’atacu in antis de s’arbèschida.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Cun su càmbiu dae su cuartu a sa metade de mìgliu de cursa, sa velotzidade est divènnida prus pagu de importu e sa resistèntzia est divènnida una netzessidade assoluta.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Est craru chi unu curridore de mesu mìgliu de prima classe, un’òmine chi podet bìnchere sos duos minutos, depet tènnere unu bella cantidade de velotzidade, ma sa resistèntzia depet essere traballada a totu sos costos.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Carchi cursa de sartu in s’ierru, cumbinada cun su traballu in palestra pro sa parte arta de su corpus, est sa preparatzione mègius pro s’istagione de cursa.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Sas pràticas de alimentatzione curretas a sa sola non podent generare prestatziones de calidade arta, ma podent interessare meda su benèssere generale de sos atletas giòvanos.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Poderare un’ecuilìbriu de energia sana, pratichende condutas de idratatzione eficatze, e cumprendende sos vàrios aspetos de sas pràticas de integratzione podet agiudare a sos atletas a megiorare sas prestatziones e crèschere su gosu issoro de s’isport.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Sa cursa de mèdia distàntzia est un’isport relativamente de pagu isperdìtziu; de cada manera, bi sunt pregiudìtzios subra su pagu echipagiamentu netzessàriu pro partetzipare.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Sos produtos podent èssere comporados cando serbint, ma sa majoria ant a tènnere pagu o perunu efetu in sa prestatzione.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Sos atletas podent tènnere sa sensatzione de prefèrrere unu produtu fintzas cando non frunit perunu vantàgiu reale.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: S’àtomu podet èssere cunsideradu comente unu de sos blocos de fràigu fundamentales de totu sa matèria.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Est un’entidade cumplicada a beru, chi cunsistit, segundu unu modellu simprificadu de Bohr, de unu nùcleu tzentrale inghiriadu dae eletrones, cosa sìmile a sos pianetas chi inghìriant su sole - pòmpia sa Figura 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Su nùcleu cunsistit de duas partitzellas - neutrones e protones.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Sos protones tenent càrriga elètrica positiva, mentras sos neutrones non tenent peruna càrriga. Sos eletrones tenent càrriga elètrica negativa.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Pro controllare sa vìtima, in antis depes esaminare s’iscena pro garantire sa seguresa tua.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Depes osservare sa positzione de sa vìtima cando ses acostende·ti a issa e cale si siat àteru signale de allarme.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Si ti ingolles proende a agiudare, dias pòdere isceti serbire a fàghere peus sas cosas.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: S’istùdiu at iscobertu chi sa depressione, sa timoria e su catastrofismu mediaiant sa relatzione intre dolore e disabilidade in sos chi patiant dolore de lumbos.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Petzi sos efetos de su catastrofismu, e non de depressione e timoria, fiant cunditzionados dae sas sessiones regulares una borta a sa chida de ativitade fìsica istruturada.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Cussos chi partetzipaiant a s’atividade regulare teniant bisòngiu de prus suportu subra s’atibbitzione de su dolore, partzende su dolore crònicu e su disàgiu dae su movimentu fìsicu normale.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Sa bista, o sa capatzidade de bìdere, dipendet dae sos òrganos sensoriales de su sistema de sa bista, o ogros.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Bi sunt medas costrutziones diferentes de ogros, classificadas subra de sa complessidade chi dipendet dae sas netzessidades de s’organismu.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Sas costrutziones diferentes tenent capatzidades diferentes, sunt sensìbiles a diferentes longàrias de unda e tenent diferentes grados de agudesa, e tenent bisòngiu fintzas de protzessos diferentes pro dare sentidu a sos istìmulos e diferentes nùmeros pro funtzionare in manera otimale.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Una populatzione est una regorta de organismos de una genia particulare in intro de un’àrea geogràfica dada.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Cando totu sos indivìduos de una populatzione sunt idènticos cunforma a una caraterìstica fenotìpica particulare sunt connotos comente monomòrficos.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Cando sos individuos mustrant paritzas variantes de una caraterìstica particulare sunt polimòrficos.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Sas colònias de formigas legionàrias tràmudant e faghent su niu in fases diferentes etotu.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: In sa fase de migratzione, sas formigas legionàrias tràmudant a su note e si firmant pro s’acampare durante sa die.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Sa colònia cumintzat una fase de tràmuda cando su màndigu a disponimentu mènguat. Durante custa fase, sa colònia faghet nios temporales chi càmbiat cada die.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Cada una de custas iscurreras o martzas durant prus o mancu 17 dies.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Ite est sa tzèllula? Su faeddu tzèllula benit dae su latinu “cella”, chi cheret nàrrere “aposentu piticu”, e fiat istadu coniadu pro primu dae unu microscopista chi osservaiat s’istrutura de s’oltìgiu.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Sa tzèllula est s’unidade bàsica de totu sas cosas biventes, e totu sos organismos sunt cumpostos dae una o prus tzèllulas.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Sas tzèllulas sunt tanti bàsicas e netzessàrias pro s’istùdiu de sa vida, difatis, sunt definidas a s’ispissu comente “sos matones de su fràigu de sa vida”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Su sistema nervosu poderat omeòstasi imbiende impulsos de nèrvios in totu su corpus pro chi su flussu de su sàmbene sigat in manera inalterada.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Custos impulsos nervosos podent èssere imbiados tanti a sa lestra pro su corpus, su chi agiudat a l’amparare dae cale si siat minetza potentziale.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Sos tornados ferrent un’àrea pitica cumparada a àteras istrachias violentas, ma podent isciusciare totu in su caminu issoro.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Sos tornados nde bogant matas dae sas raighinas, istrapare asses dae sos fràigos e fàghere bolare veturas in chelu. Su duos pro chentu prus violentu de sos tornados durant prus de tres oras.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Custas istrachias ispantosas tenent bentos de 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Sos umanos ant fatu e impreadu lentes pro ammaniare pro mizas e mizas de annos.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: De cada manera, sos primos telescòpios reales sunt istado fatos in Europa a sa fine de su de 16 sèculos.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Custos telescòpios impreaiant una cumbinatzione de duas lentes pro fàghere sos ogetos a tesu prus acanta e prus mannos.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Asurèntzia e egoismu ant a èssere semper cun nois e est sa natura de sa cooperatzione chi cando su profetu est majore b’at a èssere semper prus de guadangiare in su tèrmine curtzu cun condutas egoistas
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: S’isperat chi gente meda at a cumprèndere chi s’optzione mègius in su tèrmine longu est de traballare paris cun àteres.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Zente meda bisat sa die in ue sos umanos ant a pòdere tramudare a un’àteru isteddu e esplorare àteros mundos, àtera zente cheret ischire ite b’at foras àteros creent chi sos alienos o àteras vidas si podent agatare in un’àtera mata.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Ma, si custu mai at a sutzèdere no at a èssere pro unu tempus longu meda. Sos isteddos sunt tanti ispaniados chi bi sunt biliones de mìglios intre un’isteddu e sos “bighinos”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Forsis una die sos nebodes de sos nebodes tuos ant a istare in unu mundu alienu chirchende de ischire cosas subra de sos antenados antigos issoro?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Sos animales sunt fatos de medas tzèllulas. Papant cosas e las digerint a intru. Bona parte de sos animale si podent mòvere.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Petzi sos animales tenent cherveddu (mancari non totu sos animales: sas medusas non nde tenent, pro esèmpiu).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Sos animales s’agatant in totu sa terra. Iscavant sa terra, nadant in s’otzèanu e bolant in su chelu.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Una tzèllula est s’unidade istruturale e futnzionale prus pitica de un’organismu (èssere) bivente.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Tzèllula benit dae su faeddu latinu cella chi cheret nàrrere aposentu piticu.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Si càstias sos èsseres biventes cun su microscòpiu, at a bìdere ca sunt fatos de cuadros o tzìrculos piticos.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, unu biòlogu de s’Inghilterra, aiat bidu cuadros piticos in s’oltìgiu cun unu microscòpiu.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Pariant aposentos. Fiat sa prima persone a osservare tzèllulas mortas.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Sos elementos e sos cumpostos podent mòvere dae un’istadu a s’àteru e non cambiare.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Su nitrògenu comente gasu tenet sas matessi propiedades de su nitrògenu lìcuidu. S’istadu lìcuidu est prus densu ma sas molècolas sighent a èssere sas matessi.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: S’abba est un’àteru esempru. Su cumpostu de abba est fatu dae duos àtomos de idrògenu e un’àtomu de ossìgenu.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Tenet sa matessi istrutura molecolare siat chi siat gasu, lìcuida o sòlida.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Mancari s’istadu fìsicu potzat cambiare, s’istadu chìmicu abarrat su matessi.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Su tempus est una cosa chi est a inghìriu de nois e interessat totu su chi faghimus, mancari siat difìtzile a cumprèndere.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Su tempus est istadu istudiadu dae religiosos, filòsofos e iscientziados pro mizas de annos.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Tenimus esperièntzia de su tempus comente de una sèrie de eventos chi colant dae su benidore tràmite su presente finas a su passadu.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Su tempus est puru sa manera cun sa chi cumparamus sa durada (longària) de sos eventos.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Podes signare su colare de su tempus tue etotu osservende sa torrada de eventos tzìclicos. Un’eventu tzìclicu est una cosa chi torrat a acuntèssere prus bortas cun regularidade.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Sos elaboradores oe sunt impreados pro manipulare fotografias e vìdeos.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Animatziones sofisticadas podent èssere fraigadas in sos elaboradores, e custa genia de animatziones est impreada semper de prus in sa televisione e in sos films.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Sa mùsica a s’ispissu est registrada impreende elaboradores sofisticados pro protzessare e ammisturare a pare sos sonos.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Pro unu tempus longu durante sos sèculos deghennoe e binti, si pensaiat chi sos primos abitantes de sa Noa Zelanda èsserent su pòpulu Maori, chi cassaiant pillones gigantes numenados moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Sa teoria tando aiat istabilidu s’idea chi su pòpulu Maori aiat tramudadu dae Polinèsia in una Flota Manna e pigadu sa Noa Zelanda dae sos Moriori, istabilende una sotziedade agrìcola.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: De cada manera, una proa noa sugeirt chi sos Moriori fiant unu grupu Maori de sa terra firma chi aiat tramudadu dae sa Noa Zelanda a sas Ìsulas Chatham, isvilupende sa cultura distintiva patziìfica issoro.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Bi fiat fintzas un’àtera tribù in sas Ìsulas Chatham custos fiant Maori chi aiant tramudadu dae sa Noa Zelanda.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Si fiant numenados Moriori bi fiant istadas unas cuntierras e a sa fine sos Moriori fiant istados bogados
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Sos individuos che fiant istados interessados pro paritzos decènnios nos ant agiudadu a dare balore a sas fortzas e passiones nostras mentras ant istimadu cun sintzeridade sas dificultades e fintzas sos fallimentos.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Ascurtende a sas persones cumpartzende sas istòrias individuales, de famìllia e de organizatzione issoro, amus achiridu una connoschènzia de balore subra de su passadu e sas personalidades chi ant influentzadu in su bene o in su male sa cultura de s’organizatzione.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Mancari a cumprèndere s’istòria de cada unu non suponet sa cumprensione de sa cultura, a su mancu agiudat a sas persones a achirire unu sentidu de in ue sunt rutos a intru de s’istòria de s’organizatzione.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Istimende sos sutzessos e diventende cussentes de sos fallimentos, sos individuos e sa totalidade de sas persones chi partetzipant iscoberrent prus a fundu sos balores, sa missione e sas fortzas chi ghiant s’organizatzione.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: In custu casu, torrare a cramare esempros pretzedentes de conduta imprenditoriale e sos sutzessos cunsighentes at agiudadu a sas persones a èssere abertas a càmbios noos e a una diretzione noa pro sa crèsia de su logu.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Custas istòrias de sutzessu mènguant sa timoria de su càmbiu, creende inclinatziones positivas fache a sos càmbios in su benidore.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Sos ischemas de pensamentu cunvergente sunt tècnicas de solutzione de problemas chi aunint ideas o campos diferentes pro agatare una solutzione.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Su tzentru de custa mentalidade est lestresa, lògica e pretzisione, e puru identificatzione de sos fatos, torrare a aplicare tècnicas chi esistint giai, regòllere informatziones.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Su fatore prus de importu de custa mentalidade est: b’at petzi una risposta giusta. Tue pensas petzi a duas rispostas, est a nàrrere giusta o isballiada.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Custa genia de pensamentu est assotziadu cun carchi protzedura iscientìfica o istandard.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Sas persones cun custa genia de pensamentu tenent mentalidade lògica, sunt capatzes de regordare ischemas, risòlvere problemas e traballare cun proas iscientìficas.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Sos umanos sunt de meda sa genia prus talentosa pro lèghere sas mentes de sos àteros.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Custu cheret nàrrere chi ischimus predire in manera curreta ite atibint, bolent, creent, ischint o disizant sos àteros umanos.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Intre custas capatzidades, cumprèndere sas intentziones de sos àteros est detzisivu. Nos permitit de risòlvere ambiguidades possìbiles de sas atzione fìsicas.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Pro esempru, si bides a calicunu arroghende sa ventana de una vetura, est probàbile chi penses chi siat proende a furare sa vetura de un’istranzu.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Si diat dèpere giudicare in manera diferente si isse àeret pèrdidu sas craes e fiat sa vetura sua sa chi fiat proende a arrogare.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI est basada subra de unu fenòmenu fìsicu numenadu resonàntzia magnètica nucleare (NMR), chi fiat istadu iscobertu in sos annos 30 dae Felix Bloch (chi traballaiat in s’Universidade de Stanford) e Edwrd Purcell (dae s’Universidade de Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: In custa resonàntzia, su campu magnèticu e sas undas ràdiu istìmulant sos àtomos a emìtere signales ràdiu piticos.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: In su 1970, Raymond Damadian, unu dotore in meighinas e iscientziadu chircadore, aiat iscobertu sa base pro impreare sas imàgines de resonàntzia magnètica comente aina pro sas diàgnosis clìnicas.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Bator annos a pustis fiat istadu assignadu unu brevetu, chi fiat su primu brevetu assignadu in su mundu pro su campu de sa MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: In su 1977, Dr Damadian aiat cumpletadu su fràigu de su primu iscansionadore MRI pro totu su corpus, chi aiat numenadu “Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Sa comunicatzione asìncrona incoràgiat su tempus pro riflètere e pro sa reatzione cara a sos àteros.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Custu favoresset sa capatzidade de sos istudiantes de traballare cun su passu issoro e controllare s’istadu de s’informatzione de imparu.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: In prus, bi sunt pagus restritziones de tempus cun sa possibilidade de oràrios de traballu flessìbiles. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: S’impreu de ìnternet e de sa rete mondiale permitit a sos istudiantes de tènnere atzessu a sas informatziones in cada momentu.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Sos istudiantes podent puru imbiare preguntas a sos istrutores in cada momentu de sa die e isetare rispostas mancari lestras, prus chi isetare finas a s’addòbiu cara a cara imbeniente.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Sa prospetiva post moderna subra s’’aprendimentu frunit sa libertade dae sos assolutos. No b’at una manera bella de aprèndere ebbia.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Difatis, no b’at isceti una cosa bella de aprèndere.Aprèndere acuntesset in s’esperièntzia tra chie aprendete e sa connoschèntzia presentada.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: S’esperièntzia atuale nostra cun totu su faghe a sa sola e sa presentatzione de informatziones, programmas de televisione basados subra de s’aprendimentu mustrat custu puntu.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Medas de nois s’agatant pompiende unu programma de televisione chi nos informat subra de unu protzessu o un’esprièntzia in ue mai amus a pòdere partetzipare o aplicare custa connoschèntzia.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: No amus a fàghere mai sa revisione de una vetura, fraigare una funtana in pratza nostra, viagiare in Perù a istudiare ruinas antigas, o torrare a fàghere sa domo de su bighinu nostru.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Gràtzias a sos collegamentos de firba òtica a suta de mare cara a s’Europa e a su satèllite de banda lada, sa Groenlàndia est connètida bene cun su 93% de sa populatzione chi tenet atzessu a ìnternet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: S’albergu o chie t’ospedat (si ses in una pensione o una domo privada) est probàbile chi apat a tènnere wifi o un’elaboradore connètidu a ìnternet, e totu sas biddas tenent un’ìnternet cafè o carchi logu cun wifi pùblicu.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Comente nadu innantis, mancari su faeddu “eschimesu” andat bene in sos Istados Unidos, pro meda pòpulos àrticos est unu faeddu lègiu, pruschetotu in Cànada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Mancari potzas intèndere a sos nativos groenlandesos imperende custu faeddu, sos furisteris no lu dd'aiant a dèpere imperare.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Sos abitantes nativos de sa Groenlàndia si tzèrriant Inuit in Cànada e Kalaalleq (plurali Kalaallit), groenlandesu, in Groenlàndia.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Su malu fàghere e sa mala idea contra a sos istràngios in generale in Groenlàndia n pràtica sunt disconnotos. Fintzas in sas biddas, non b’at “àreas difìtziles”.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Su tempus fritu podet dare chi siat s’ùnicu perìgulu chi unu chi no est preparadu podet afrontare.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Si bìsitas sa Groenlàndia in sas istajones fritas (tenende contu chi cantu prus andas a nord, prus fritu at a fàghere), tocat de ti pigare bestimenta bastante caente.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Sas dies longas meda in istiu podent batire problemas in su de dormire su tempus giustu e disturbos assotziados a sa salude.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Durante s’istiu, est a dare cara puru a sa zìnzula de su nord. Mancari non apìtzighet peruna maladia, podet dare pistighìngiu.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Mentras s’economia de San Francisco est ligada a èssere un’atratzione turìstica de òrdine mundiale, s’economia sua est diversificada.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Sos setores de traballu prus ampros sunt sos servìtzios professionales, guvernu, finàntzia, cummèrtziu e turismu.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Sa rapresentatzione frecuente in mùsica, film, literadura e cultura popolare at agiudadu a connòschere sa tzitade e sos puntos de interessu sous in totu su mundu.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco at isvilupadu un’infrastrutura turìstica manna cun medas albergos, ristorantes, e istruturas pro cunvegnos de calidade arta meda.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco est puru unu de sos mègius logos de sa natzione pro àteras coghinas de Àsia: coreana, tailandesa, indiana e giaponesa.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Andare a su Walt Disney World est su pellegrinàgiu prus mannu pro medas famìllias americanas.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Sa bìsita “tìpica” cumportat bolare finas a s’Orlando International Airport, andare in postale in un’albergu Disney in loco, colare una chida prus o mancu sena lassare sa propiedade Disney e torrare a domo.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Bi sunt variatziones infinitas, ma custu abarrat su chi sa parte manna de sas persones cherent nàrrere cando faeddant de “andare a Disney World”.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Medas de sos billetes bèndidos in lìnia tràmite sitos de asta comente eBay o Craiglist sunt billetes de segunda manu pro prus dies in su parcu.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Mentras custa est un’atividade comune a beru, est vetada dae Disney: sos billetes non sunt trasferìbiles.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Pro calisisiat acampamentu asuta de su Grand Canyon serbit unu permissu pro sas terras de aìntro.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Sos permissos funt limitados pro amparare su canyon e funt a disponimentu sa prima die de su mese, bator meses innantis de su mese de comintzu.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Pro cussu, unu permissu pro sas terras de aìntro pro calisisiat data dae comintz de Màju est vàlidu dae su primu de Gennàlzu.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Su logu pro sas zonas prus trafficadas comente su Bright Angel Campground affàcca de su Phantom Ranch, sa prus de sas bortas si pieanat cun sas dimandas fatas a sa prima data de abbertùra de sos apuntamentos.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Bi sunt unu nùmeru serradu de permissos arribados pro sas dimandas de intrada chena apuntamentu, a disponimentu segundu s'òrdine de arrivu.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Intrare in Sudàfrica a vetura est una manera ispantosa pro bìdere totu sas bellesas de sa regione gasi comente lòmpere a sos logos foras dae sos caminos turìsticos normales.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Custu si podet fàghere in una vetura normale cun una pianificatzione atenta ma una vetura 4x4 est cussigiada e medas logos sunt atzessìbiles isceti cun rodas 4x4 artas.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Ammenta·ti cando organizas chi mancari su Sudàfrica siat istàbile non totu sos paisos acanta lu sunt.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Sas rechestas e sos costos de vistu càmbiant dae natzione a natzione e dipendent dae su paisu dae ue benis.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Cada paisu in prus tenet leges ùnicas chi òrdinant ite ogetos de emergèntzia depent èssere in sa vetura.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls est una tzitade in sa portzione ovest de su Zimbabwe, in sa làcana cun Livingstone, su Zàmbia e acanta de su Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Sa tzitade s’agatat deretu acanta de sos istrampos, e sunt sas atratziones printzipales, ma custa destinatzione turìstica populare frunit siat a chie chircat aventuras siat a chie cheret bìdere panoramas unu muntone de oportunidades pro abarrare unu tempus prus longu.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: In s’istagione de sas piòpidas (dae Santandria a Martzu), su volume de s’abba podet èssere prus artu e sos istrampos podent èssere prus ispetaculares.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Est seguru chi t’as a isciùndere si atraessas su ponte o caminas pro sos caminos trotos acanta de sos Istrampos.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: A s’àtera banda, est pròpiu pro more de chi su volume de s’abba est gasi artu chi sa bista de sos Istrampos reales podet èssere istorbada - dae totu s’abba!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Sa tumba de Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 podet èssere sa prus connota de sas tumbas in sa Badde, iscenàriu de s’iscoberta de Howard Carter in su 1922 de sa casi intata tumba reale de su rei giòvanu.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Cumparada cun bona parte de sas àteras tumbas reales, de cada manera, sa tumba de Tutankhamun balit apenas sa pena de èssere visitada, ca est meda prus pitica e cun decoratziones limitadas.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Chie siat interessadu a bìdere sa proa de su dannu a sa mùmmia fatu durante sos tentativos de nde la bogare dae su baule at a abarrare delùdidu ca sunt visìbiles isceti sa conca e sas palas.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Sas richesas ispantosas de sa tumba non sunt prus a intro, ma sunt istadas batidas a su Museu Egìtziu in Càiru.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Sos visitadores cun pagu tempus diant pòdere colare su tempus issoro a un’àtera parte.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, a 12 km a sudovest dae Siem Reap. Custu tèmpiu subra unu cùcuru fiat istadu fraigadu a sa fine de su de 9 sèculos, durante su regnu de su Re Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: S’atmosfera iscura de su tèmpiu e sa bista subra su lagu Tonle Sap balent sa pena de nche pesare in su cùcuru.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Una visita a su situ podet èssere cumbinada bene cun un’escursione cun sa barca a su lagu.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Est netzessàriu su Angkor Pass pro intrare in su tèmpiu tando no ismèntighes de batire su passaportu tuo cando andas a su Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Gerusalemme est sa capitale e sa tzitade prus manna de Israele, mancari sa majoria de sos àteros paisos e sas Natziones Unidas no la reconnoschent comente capitale de Israele.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Sa tzitade antiga in sos Montes Giudeos tenet un’istòria incantadora chi imprassat mizas de annos.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Sa tzitade est santa pro sas tres religiones monoteistas - Giudaismu, Cristianesimu e Islam, e est unu tzentru ispirituale, religiosu e culturale.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Pro more de su sentidu religiosu de sa tzitade, e in particulare de medas sitos de s’àrea de sa Tzitade Antiga, Gerusalemme est una de sas destinatziones printzipales in Israele.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Gerusalemme tenet medas sitos istòricos, archeològicos e culturales, paris cun tzentros cummertziales vibrantes e prenos de gente, bar e ristorantes.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: S’Ecuador pedit chi sos tzitadinos cubanos retzant una lìtera de invitu in antis de intrare in Ecuador dae sos aeroportos internatzionales o puntos de ammissione in sa frontiera.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Custa lìtera depet èssere legalizada dae su Ministèriu de sos Afàrios Èsteros de Ecuador, e respetare carchi rechisitu.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Custos rechisitos sunt seberados pro frunire unu flussu de migratzione organizadu intre sos duos paisos.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Sos tzitadinos cubanos chi tenent una carta birde USA diant dèpere visitare su Consoladu Ecuadorianu pro otènnere s’esentzione dae custu rechisitu.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Su passaportu tou depet èssere bàlidu pro a su nessi 6 ses meses a pustis de sas datas de su biazu. Serbit unu billete de biazu andada/torrada pro iscumproare sa durada de s’istonzu.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Sos giros sunt prus baratos pro sos grupos prus mannos, pro cussu si ses a contu tou o petzi cun un’amigu, proa a connòschere a àteras persones e forma unu grupu de bator finas a ses persones pro una mezus tarifa a persone.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: In cada manera, custu non ti diat dèpere pertocare, ca a s'ispissu sos turistas coitant a los tramudare pro nche prenare sas veturas.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Paret chi b’apat prus de una manera pro li fàghere crèere a sos turistas chi depent pagare de prus.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ismutzurrende subra de su cabu nord de Machu Picchu b’est custu monte in pigada, a s’ispissu s’isfundu de paritzas fotos de sas ruinas.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Paret unu pagu ispantosu dae suta, e est un’artziada ràbida e matanosa, ma su prus de sas persones sanas diant dèpere èssere capassas de bi la fàghere in pagu prus o mancu 45 minutos.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Sos gradinos de pedra bi sunt in su prus de su caminu, e in sas setziones prus a trocos cavos de atarzu frunint unu passamanu de suportu.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Naradu custu, iseta·ti de abarrare chena alenu, e dae cara in sos tretos prus ràbidos, mescamente cando est ùmidu, dae chi de repente podet divènnere perigulosu.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: B’at una gruta minoredda a curtzu de su cùcuru dae cue tocat de colare, est unu pagu bassa e est unu logu bastante istrintu.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Pro bìdere sos giassos e sa bida agreste de sas Galàpagos sa cosa mègius est dae sa barca, comente aiat fatu Charles Darwin etotu in su 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Prus de 60 crotzeras in barca surcant sas abbas de sas Galàpagos - colende in mèdia dae 8 a 100 passigeris.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Su prus de sas persones prenotant su logu meda in antìtzipu (dae chi sas barcas sunt semper prenas in s’istajone arta).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Segura·ti chi s’agente cun chie prenotas siat unu pràticu de Galàpagos chi connoscat bene una variedade manna de barcas.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Custu t’at a segurare chi sos interessos e/o vìnculos particulares tuos siant in cuncordu cun sa barca prus adata a custos.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: In antis de èssere arribados sos ispanniolos in su de 16 sèculos, su cabu de nord de su Tzile fiat suta de su domìniu Inca cando sos indìgenos Araucanians (Mapuche) istaiant in su Tzile tzentrale e meridionale.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Su Mapuche fiat fintzas unu de sos ùrtimos grupos indìgenos indipendentes de s’Amèrica, chi non nche fiat istadu tzuspidu de su totu dae su domìniu de su faeddare ispanniolu finas a a pustis de s’indipendèntzia de su Tzile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Mancari su Tzile àeret decraradu s’indipendèntzia in su 1810 (intre sas gherras napoleònicas chi pro una pàriga de annos aiant lassadu s’Ispagna chena unu guvernu tzentrale chi esseret funtzionadu), sa vitòria detzisiva contra a sos ispanniolos non l’ant lograda finas a su 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Sa Repùblica Dominicana (in spanniolu República Dominicana) est unu paisu caraìbicu chi leat sa metade a avréschida de s’ìsula de Hispaniola, a mesa e pare cun Haiti
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Umpare a sas ispiàggias biancas e a sos paesàggios de muntàgna, in su paese s’agatat sa prus antiga tzitadi europea de sas Amèricas, chi còmo faghet parte de Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: A su comintzu s’ìsula fut abbitada dae sos Tainos e dae sos Caribes. Sos Caribes fiant unu pòpulu chi faeddaiat su arawak arrividos prus o mancu in su 10,000 i.C. (innantis de Cristu).
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: In pagos annos apustis de s'arrivu de sos esploradores europeos, sa populatzione de Tainos fuit istata minimada dae sos conchistadores ispanniolos
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Segundu su cóntu de Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de Las Indias) intra de su 1492 e su 1498 sos conchistadores spanniolos ant bocchìdu prus o mancu 100.000 Tainos.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Custu ispàtziu l’ant fraigadu comente intrada de unu cunventu de su de 17 sèculos, de custu su tèmpiu de San Diego est s’ùnicu fràigu chi nch’est abarradu.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Como funtzionat comente pratza tzentrale e est semper ocupada, a de die e a de note.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: B’at unu nùmeru de ristorantes chi inghìriant su giardinu, e a bortaedie e a sero b’at cuntzertos a in donu medas bortas ofertos dae su muristene tzentrale.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Gùturu de su basu). Duos pogiolos separados dae petzi 69 tzentìmetros sunt su logu de una legenda de amore.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Pro pagos soddos carchi pitzinnu t’at a contare s’istòria.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: S’Ìsula de Bowen est unu biazu pobulare de una die o un'escursione de unu fine de chida chi oferit kayak, escursiones, butegas, ristorantes e àteru puru.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Custa comunidade de su logu nch’est in Howe Sound apenas in fora de Vancouver, e si podet andare chena dificultades cun su taxi de abba de lìnia chi moet dae s’ìsula de Granville in su tzentru de Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: A cuddos chi lis piaghent sas atividades in foras, est fundamentale una passigiada finas su curridore de Sea to Sky.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 ora cun sa vetura dae Vancouver) est cara ma de bona fama pro sas olimpìades de ierru de su 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: In ierru, godi·ti unu pagu de su mezus iscì de su Nord Amèrica, e in istiu proa unu pagu de mountain bike verdaderu.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.
