text: Sos permissos est a los prenotare in antis. Depes tènnere su permissu pro colare sa note in sa Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sa Sirena est s’ùnica istatzione de forestales chi ponet a disponimentu s’allògiu in su dormitòriu e pastos caentes in annanta a su campègiu. La Leona, San Pedrillo e Los Patos oferint petzi su campègiu chena servìtziu de ristoratzione.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Est possìbile a s’assegurare sos permissos pro su parchègiu in s’istatzione de sos forestales etotu in Puerto Jiménez, ma no atzetant sas cartas de crèditu
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Su servìtziu de su parcu (MINAE) non dat permissos de parchègiu prus de unu mese in antis de lòmpere.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol dat unu servìtziu de prenotatzione pro una tassa de US $ 30, o $ 10 pro sos permissos pro una die; detàllios in sa pàgina issoro de Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Sas ìsulas Cook sunt unu paisu ìsula in assòtziu lìberu cun sa Noa Zelanda, collacadas in Polinesia, e in mesu de s’Otzèanu Patzìficu de su sud.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Est un’artzipèlagu de 15 ìsulas ispartinadas in 2,2 milliones de Km2 de otzèanu.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Cun su matessi fusu oràriu de sas Hawaii, a bortas sas ìsulas si cunsìderant "sas Hawaii de giosso".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Mancari prus minore, l’ammentat a carchi bisitadore antzianu sas Hawaii cando galu non fiant un’istadu chena totu sos albergos turìsticos mannos e àteru isvilupu.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Sas ìsulas Cook non tenent àteras tzitades ma si cumponent de 15 ìsulas diferentes. Sas prus de importu sunt Rarotonga e Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: In sos paisos isvilupados oe, su de fàghere su servìtziu de bed and breakfast de lussu nche l’ant artziadu a una casta de forma de arte.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: A livellu artu, sos B&B òviu chi si la gherrant in duas cosas printzipale: s’aposentu e s’ismurzu.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Perintantu, in sas istruturas mezus de custa genia unu podet agatare su corredu de letu prus de lussu, mancari una trapunta fata a manu o unu letu antigu.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: S’ismurzu podet inclùere delìtzias regionales de s’istajone o un’ispetzialidade de su mere de domo.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: S'ambiente diat pòdere èssere unu fràigu istòricu betzu cun mòbiles antigos, giardinos curados bene e una piscina.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Su de intrare a sa vetura e tzucare pro unu biazu longu tenet un'ammaju intrìnsecu in sa semplitzidade sua.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: A diferèntzia de sos veìculos mannos, podet dare chi tenzas giai familiaridade guidende sa vetura tua e connosches sos lìmites suos.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Su de piatzare una tenda in una propiedade privada o in una tzitade de cale si siat mannària est fàtzile chi podat atirare un’aficu chi non dias chèrrere.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: In pagas paràulas, su de impreare sa vetura tua est una bella manera pro fàghere unu biazu in caminu ma pagas bortas una manera de “fàghere campègiu” in sese.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Su campègiu in vetura faghet si tenes unu furgoneddu ampru, unu SUV, una berlina o unu station wagon cun sos setzidorzos chi si corcant.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Carchi hotel tenent una traditzione dae s’edade de oro de sas ferrovias a vapore e de sos transatlànticos; in antis de sa Segunda gherra mundiale, in su de 19 o a printzìpios de su de 20 sèculos.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Custos albergos fiant ue istaiant sos ricos e sos famosos de su tempus, e a s’ispissu teniant una coghina rafinada e vida a de note.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Faghent parte de su caràtere issoro sas finiduras de gustu antigu, sa mancàntzia de sas amenidades prus modernas e unu tzertu garbu galanu.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Sende chi a su sòlitu sunt de propiedade privada, a bortas retzint a cabos de istadu in bìsita o a àteras figuras istitutzionales.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Unu biazadore cun unu muntone de dinare diat pòdere cunsiderare unu bolu a inghìriu de su mundu, segadu cun sogiornos in medas de custos albergos.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Una rete pro cuncambiare s’ospitalidade est s’organizatzione chi ponet in cuntatu sos biazadores cun sa zente de su logu in sas tzitades chi ant a bisitare.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: S’adesione a tale rete a su sòlitu cheret petzi a compilare su mòdulu in rete; mancari carchi rete disponzat o pedat una verìfica in annanta.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Si frunit una lista de sos retzidores a disponimentu in pabiru e/o in sa rete, a bortas cun riferimentos o parres de àteros biazadores.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing est istada fundada in Gennarzu de su 2004 a pustis chi su programmadore informàticu Casey Fenton aiat atzapadu unu bolu baratu pro s’Islanda ma non teniat unu logu ue istare.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: L’aiat mandadu unu messàgiu de posta eletrònica a sos istudiantes de s’universidade de su logu e aiat retzidu unu nùmeru istravanadu de ofertas de allògios in donu.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Sas posadas in antis totu serbint a sos zòvanos - un’istranzu tìpicu tenet prus o mancu binti annos - ma medas bortas podes agatare fintzas biazadores prus mannos.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Sas famìlias cun pitzinnos sunt una bisione rara, ma carchi posada lis lassat aposentos privados.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Sa tzitade de Pechinu in Tzina at a retzire sos Giogos olìmpicos de ierru in su 2022, chi l’ant a fàghere sa prima tzitade a àere ospitadu siat sas Olimpìades de istiu chi sas de ierru.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pechinu at a istranzare sas tzerimònias de abertura de cungiada e sas garas in intro in s’àstragu.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Àteras garas de iscì s’ant a fàghere in s’àrea isciìstica de Taizicheng in Zhangjiakou, a prus o mancu 220 km (140 mìgias) dae Pechinu.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Sa majoria de sos tèmpios tenet unu fèstival annuale chi cumintzat dae s'agabbu de Santandria a metade de Maju, chi càmbiat cunforma a su calendàriu annuale de cada tèmpiu.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Su prus de sos fèstival si festant comente parte de s'anniversàriu de su tèmpiu o presidende su cumpleannu de sa divinidade o cale si siat àteru eventu majore assotziadu cun su tèmpiu.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Sos fèstival de su tèmpiu de Kerala sunt interessantes meda de bìdere, cun sa protzessione sòlita de elefantes decorados, s’orchestra de su tèmpiu e àteras festividades.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Una fiera mundiale (in generale narada espositzione mundiale, o petzi Expo) est unu grandu fèstival internatzionale de artes e sièntzias.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Sos paisos chi partètzipant presentant mustras artìsticas e educativas in sos padilliones natzionales pro mustrare sas chistiones de su mundu o sa cultura e s’istòria de sos paisos issoro.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Sas Espositziones internatzionales de orticultura sunt eventos ispetzializados chi ponent in mustra cumpositziones de frores, giardinos botànicos e cale si siat àtera cosas chi pertocat sas prantas.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Mancari in teoria podet tènnere logu cada annu (bastante chi siant in paisos diferentes), in pràtica non sunt gasi.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Custos eventos comente norma durant in totue dae tres a ses meses, e si tenent in logos non prus minores de 50 ètaros.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: B’at parìtzos formados de pellìcula chi si sunt impreados in su cursu de sos annos. Sa pellìcula istandard de 35 mm (negativu de 36 x 24 mm) est sa prus comuna meda.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: A su sòlitu si podet torrare a prenare chena dificultades cando si nche finit e oferit una risolutzione chi prus o mancu si podet paragonare cun una DSLR atuale.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Calchi fotocàmera a pellìcula de formadu mèdiu impreat unu formadu 6 pro 6 cm, prus de pretzisu unu negativu 56 x 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Custu dat una risolutzione casi bator bortas tantu sa de unu negativu de 35 mm (3136 mm2 contra 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Sa fàuna agreste est intre sos temas chi prus lis dant gherra a unu fotògrafu e li bisonzat un’ammisturu de fortuna, passèntzia, esperièntzia e atretzadura bona.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: A sa fotografia naturalìstica a s’ispissu non li si dat su balore giustu, ma comente a sa fotografia in generale, un’immàgine balet cantu a milli paràulas.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Sa fotografia naturalìstica a s'ispissu cheret unu teleobietivu longu, mancari bi cherzant àteras lentes pro cosas che a una gama de pugiones o un'animaleddu minore.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Medas animales esòticos sunt malos a agatare e a bortas sos parcos tenent règulas subra su de tirare fotografias pro fines cummertziales.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Sos animales agrestes podent èssere timurosos o malearrimados. S’ambiente diat pòdere èssere fritu, caente o sinunca ostile.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Su mundu tenet prus de 5.000 limbas diferentes, de custas prus de binti cun 50 milliones o prus de faeddadores.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Sas paràulas iscritas medas bortas sunt fintzas prus fàtziles de cumprèndere rispetu a sas pronuntziadas. Custu est beru in particulare pro sos indiritzos, chi a s'ispissu sunt difìtzile de pronuntziare in manera chi si cumprendant.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: In medas natziones intreas sunt isortos de su totu in inglesu, e in galu de prus ti podes isetare unu connoschimentu limitadu - mescamente intre sos prus giòvanos.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Immàgina·ti, si cheres, unu de Manchester, de Boston, de sa Giamàiaca e de Sydney sètzidos a inghìriu de una mesa chenende in unu ristorante de Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Si sunt donende s’unu cun s’àteru contos de sas tzitades issoro, contados cun sos atzentos diferentes issoro e su faeddu de su logu.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Su de comporare su màndigu in su supermercadu a su sòlitu est sa manera prus barata pro s’alimentare. Non podende coghinare, sos issèberos sunt limitados a su màndigu giai prontu.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Semper prus supermercados sunt batinde una setzione semper prus vària de màndigu prontu. Unos cantos frunint fintzas unu furru a micro-undas o àteros mèdios pro si cantare su recatu.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: In unos cantos paisos o genias de butegas b’at semper unu ristorante in cue etotu, a s’ispissu bastante informale e cun prejos baratos.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Faghe·ti e piga·ti in fatu còpias de sa pòlitza e de su cuntatu de s’asseguradore tou.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Bisonzat chi mustrent s'indiritzu de posta eletrònica de s’asseguradore e sos nùmeros de telèfono internatzionales pro cussìgios/permissos e dare sas chèscias.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Tene una còpia fintzas in su bagàlliu e in sa rete (imbia·ti unu messàgiu de posta eletrònica cun s’alligadu, o pone·ti·lu a bandas in sa “nue virtuale”).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Si ses biazende cun unu portàtile o una tauledda, archìvia·nde una còpia in sa memòria o in su discu (a ue si podat intrare chena ìnternet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Fruni una còpia de sa pòlitza/cuntratu a sos cumpàngios de biazu puru o a sos parentes o a sos amigos in domo chi ti cherent agiudare.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Sos arcones (connotos fintzas comente chervos americanos) in sese non sunt malos, ma si difendent si s’intendent minetzados.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Cando sas persones non bident sos arcones comente chi podent èssere perigulosos, si podent acurtziare tropu e si podent pònnere in perìgulu.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Bufa sos alcòlicos cun moderu. S’alcol faghet male a totu cantos in maneras diferentes, e a connòschere sos lìmites tuos est de importu mannu.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Cunsighèntzias de dura longa possìbiles pro sa salude dèpidas a su consumu esageradu de alcol podent èssere dannos a su fìgadu e agiomai tzurpedade e morte. Su perìgulu chi bi podes èssere creschet cando si consumit alcol in manera illegale.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Sos alcòlicos illegales podent cuntènnere paritzas impuridades perigulosas che a su metanolo, chi podet causare tzurpedade o morte fintzas cun doses minores.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Sos otzales podent èssere prus baratos in unu paisu istràngiu, mescamente in sos paisos a rèdditu bassu ue su costu de su traballu est inferiore.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Piga in cunsideru sa possibilidade de fàghere un’esame de sa bista in domo, mescamente si s’asseguratzione lu coberit, e de ti leare in fatu sa retzeta de archiviare in carchi logu.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Sas montaduras de marca de livellu artu a disponimentu in tales àeras podent tènnere duos problemas; unas cantas podent èssere imitatziones e cuddas verdaderas importadas podent èssere prus caras chi in domo.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Su cafè est unu de sos benes prus trafigados de su mundu, e podet dare chi nd’agates medas castas in sa regione tua de nàschida.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Mancari gasi, in totu su mundu b’at medas maneras ispetzìficas de bufare su cafè chi balet sa pena a proare.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Su torrentismu (o: andare peri sas gulas) est a andare a su fundale de una gula, chi est o assutu o prenu de abba.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Su torrentismu ammisturat elementos de su nadonzu, de s'apiligada e de su brincu--ma bi cheret pagu allenamentu o forma fìsica pro cumintzare (rispetu a s'apiligada in sa preda, a su de andare in profundidade a intro de s’abba o a su de fàghere iscì alpinu, pro nàrrere).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: S’ecursionismu est un’atividade in foras chi est a caminare in sa natura, a s’ispissu in caminos de escursiones.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: S’escursionismu de una die cumprèndet distàntzias de prus pagu de una mìgia chi si podent cobèrrere totu in una die.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Pro un’escursione de una die peri una caminedda fàtzile bi cheret pagu s’aprontare, e cale si siat persone chi siat unu pagu allenada si los podet godire.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Pro sas famìlias cun pitzinnos bi diat pòdere chèrrere de prus a s’aprontare, ma una giorronada in foras giai faghet chena problemas fintzas cun pipios o pitzinnos chi galu no andant a iscola.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: A livellu internatzionale, b’at belle 200 organizatziones de cursas. Sa parte manna de custas traballant a contu issoro.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Sa chi est bènnida a pustis de sa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours ponet a disponimentu in sa rete doghinas de frunidores de cursa turìstica in bator continentes.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Nàschidu in su Running Tours Barcelona de Bartzelona e in su Running Copenhagen de Copenaghen, in pagu tempus l’ant postu in fatu su Running Tours Prague cun sede in Praga e àteros.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: B’at medas cosas chi depes pigare in cunsideru in antis e cando moes a carchi logu.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Cando biazas, iseta·ti chi sas cosas non siant comente a “in domo tua”. Sos costùmenes, sas lezes, su màndigu, su tràficu, s’allògiu, sos istandard, sa limba e gasi sighende ant a èssere in carchi manera diferentes dae ue istas.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Custa est una cosa chi depes tènnere a mente semper, pro evitare delusiones o mancari fintzas disgustu pro comente costumant a fàghere sas cosas in su logu.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Sas agentzias de biazu bi sunt dae su de 19 sèculos. Un’agente de biazu est a su sòlitu un’issèberu bonu pro biazos ue su biazadore non tenet esperièntzia in contu de natura, cultura, limba o paisos a rèditu bassu.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Mancari sa majoria de sas agentzias siat disposta a atzetare su prus de sas prenotatziones regulares, medas agentes sunt ispetzializados in castas de biazu particulares, bandas de disponibilidade econòmicas o destinatziones.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Podet èssere mezus a impreare un’agente chi a fiatianu prenotat biazos sìmiles a sos tuos.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Pòmpia sos biazos chi s’agente l’est faghende publitzidade, siat in unu situ ìnternet siat in una vetrina.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Si cheres bìdere su mundu a preju bonu, pro bisonzu, istile de bida o disafiu, b’at unas cantas maneras pro lu fàghere.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: In pràtica, b’at duas maneras: o traballas in su tempus chi nche ses in biazu o chircas de minimare sas ispesas. Custu artìculu si cuntzentrat subra de custu.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Pro sos chi sunt dispostos a sacrificare comodidades, tempus e prevedibilidade pro minimare sas ispesas belle a su zero, est a pompiare sa disponibilidade econòmica mìnima pro su biazu.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Su cussizu est chi sos biazadores non furent, non si nch’intrent a ue non depent, chi non partètzipent a su mercadu illegale, non pedant sa limùsina o isfrutent in carchi manera a àteras persones pro su torracontu issoro.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Unu puntu de controllu de s’immigratzione est a su sòlitu su primu passu candu si pendet dae un’aèreu, unu naviu, o un’àteru veìculu.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: In carchi trenu intre sas làcanas sas ispetziones si faghent in su trenu in cursa e dias dèpere tènnere unu documentu de identidade bàlidu cun tegus cando àrtzias a unu de cuddos trenos.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: In sos trenos a de note, su ghiadore podet rimunire sos passaportos in manera de non ti segare su sonnu.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Sa registratzione est unu rechisitu in prus pro su protzessu de su vistu. In carchi paisu tocat de marcare sa presèntzia e s’indiritzu de ue as a istare ante sas autoridades locales.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Custu diat pòdere rechèdere sa compilatzione de unu mòdulu cun sa politzia de su logu o una bìsita a sos ufìtzios.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: In medas paisos cun custa leze, sos albergos de su logu ant a gestire sa registratzione (segura·ti de dimandare).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: In sos àteros casos, petzi sos chi istant in foras de sas istruturas de retzida si depent registrare. Nointames, custu faghet chi sa leze siat crara prus pagu meda, duncas in antis est a s’informare.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: S’architetura s’òcupat de sa progetatzione e de su fràigu de sos edifìtzios. S’architetura de unu logu a s’ispissu est issa etotu un’atratzione turìstica.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Medas fràigos sunt bastante bellos de bìdere e sa bista dae un’edifìtziu artu o dae una bentana posta in su puntu giustu podet èssere una bellesa de bìdere.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: S’architetura si subraponet non pagu a sos àteros campos, de custos sa pranificatzione urbana, s’ingegneria tzivile, sas artes decorativas, su disinnu de sos internos e sa progetatzione de su paesàgiu.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Dadu cantu sunt a tesu medas pueblos, non as a èssere a tretu de agatare bida a de note meda chena ti nch’andare a Albuquerque o a Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Mancari gasi, belle totu sos casinò elencados in subra serbint cosa de bufare e medas de custos oferint intratenimentu de marca (mescamente cuddos mannos a fùrriu de Albuquerque e Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Dare cara: sos tzilleris de sas biddas minores non semper sunt logos bonos pro su bisitadore istràngiu.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Pro prima cosa, su Nou Mèssicu setentrionale tenet problemas non de pagu contu cun sa guida suta s’efetu de s’alcol e a curtzu a sos tzilleris de sas biddas minores ghiadores imbriagos bi nd’at a bundu.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Sos murales o sos iscarràfios chi non cheret nemos sunt connotos comente grafitos.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Mancari non siat unu fenòmenu modernu, su prus de sas persones podet dare chi los assòtziet a sos dannos de sos giòvanos a sos bene pùblicos e privados impreende sas bomboleddas de vernitze.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Mancari gasi, in die de oe b’at artìstas de grafitos afirmados, eventos de grafitos e muros "legales". Sas pinturas de grafitos in custu cuntestu a s’ispissu s’assimizant a òperas de arte prus che a firmas chi non si podent lèghere.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Sa ghetada de su boomerang est un'abilidade pobulare chi medas turistas cherent achirire.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Si cheres imparare a ghetare unu boomerang chi ti torrat in manos, segura·ti de tènnere unu boomerang adatu pro sa torrada.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Sa majoria de sos boomerang a disponimentu in Australia sunt difatis de sos chi non bi torrant. Pro sos chi sos cumintzende est mègius a non proare a ghetare cando b’at bentu
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Unu pastu Hangi si coghet in unu fossu caente in su terrinu.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Su fossu si caentat cun pedras buddidas dae unu fogu, o sinunca in carchi puntu ue su calore geotèrmicu caentat sas àreas de su terrinu in manera naturale.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: L'hangi est a s’ispissu impreadu pro còghere una chena traditzionale a moda de arrostu.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Vàrios logos in Rotorua oferint hangi geotèrmicos, cando chi àteros hangi si podent assazare in Christchurch, Wellington e in aterue.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail tenet duas castas de trenos chi andant e torrant a fùrriu dae Tzitade de su Cabu: MetroPlus (naradu fintzas First Class) e Metro (naradu Third Class).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus est su prus còmudu e prus pagu prenu de zente ma azigu prus caru, sende chi in cada manera prus batatu de sos billetes normales de sa metropolitana in Europa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Cada trenu zughet siat sas carrotzas MetroPlus chi Metro; sos postales MetroPlus sunt semper a sa fine de su trenu prus a curtzu de Tzitade de su Cabu.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Trasportu pro sos àteros - Non perdas mai de bista sas bursas tuas, mescamente cando rugras sas làcanas internatzionales.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Ti dias pòdere agatare a èssere impreadu comente vetore de drogas chena l’ischire, cosa chi t’at a pònnere in problemas sèrios.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Custu cumportat su de isetare a coa, ca sos canes antidroga si podent impreare in cale si siat momentu chena preavisu.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: In carchi paisu b’at punitziones tropu severas fintzas pro sos primos reatos; custos podent èssere penas de arrestu de prus de 10 annos o sa morte.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Sas bursas chena bàrdia sunt un’obietivu pro furare e podent cramare s’atentzione de sas autoridades atentas a sas minetzas de bombas.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: A domo, a càusa de custa espositzione costante a germes locales, sunt meda prus artas sas probabilidades chi sias giai immune.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Ma in àteras alas de su mundu, ue sa fàuna de batèrios est noa pro tene, est meda prus probàbile chi apas problemas.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: In prus, in sos climas prus caentes creschent ambos prus in presse e subravìvent prus tempus in fora de su corpus.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Gasi sos flagellos de Delhi Belly, sa Maleditzione de su Faraone, sa Vinditta de Montezuma e sos paritzos amigos issoro.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Comente pro sos problemas de respiratzione in sos climas prus fritos, sos problemas a s’istentina in sos climas caentes sunt bastante fitianos e pro sa majoria de sos casos dant bastante fastìdiu ma sunt pagu perigulosos.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Si biazas pro sa prima borta in unu paisu in bia de isvilupu – o in un’ala noa de su mundu – non sutavàlutes su chi podet èssere s’ispramu culturale.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Medas biazadores fitianos si bident abusados dae sa novidade de sos biazos noos peri su mundu in bia de isvilupu, ue medas acontzaduras culturales minores si podent annànghere a lestru.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Mescamente in sas primas dies, piga in cunsideru de ti nche catzare unu disizu in s'albergo, in su màndigu e in sos servìtzios in istile otzidentale e de calidade pro t'agiudare a t'ambientare.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Non dormas in tramatzas o campu-letos in zonas ue non connosches sa fàuna locale.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Si ses de s'idea de t'acampare, piga·ti una branda o unu bantziga-letu pro ti mantènnere a un'ala dae coloras, iscorpiones o animales gasi.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Prena·ti sa domo cun unu cafè a bundu a manzanu e una gramamilla pro ti pasare a notte.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Cando ses in fèrias, tenes tempus pro ti cuntentare e pro ti pigare carchi minutu in prus pro t’aprontare carchi cosa de ispetziale.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Si t’intendes prus atrividu, non perdas s’ocasione pro fàghere sùtzios o amisturare carchi frulladu:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: mancari as a iscobèrrere una cosa de bìvere fàtzile chi ti podes ammaniare pro s’ismurzu cando ses torradu a sa bida de cada die.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Si istas in una tzitade in ue b'est sa cultura de su bufonzu, bae·ti·nche a tzilleris o locales in sos bighinados chi non tratas.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Pro chie non tenet familiaridade cun su limbazu mèigu, sas paràulas infetivu e contagiosu tenent sentidos diferentes.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Una maladia infetiva est causada dae un’agente patògenu, comente a unu virus, unu batèriu, unu fungu o un’àteru parassita.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Una maladia contagiosa est una maladia chi est fàtzile chi si nch’apìtzighet agatende·si una persone in s’oru de una persone infetada.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Medas guvernos rechedent a sos bisitadores chi essint dae sos paisos issoro de si vatzinare pro una cala de maladias.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Custos rechisitos a s’ispissu pòdent dipèndere dae sos paisos chi unu biazadore at bisitadu o cheret bisitare.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Unu de sos puntos fortes de Charlotte, Carolina de Nord, est chi tenet un’abbundàntzia de séberu de calidade arta pro sas famìlias.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Sos residentes de àteras àreas a s’ispissu mentovant chi est a medida de famìlia comente prima resone pro tramudare inoghe, e sos visitadores a s’ispissu agatant sa tzitade fàtzile a gosare cun pipios a inghìriu.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: In sos 20 annos colados, sa cantidade de optziones pro pipios in Charlotte Uptown est crèschida in manera esponentziale.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Sos taxi generalmente no sunt impreados dae sas famìlias in Charlotte, mancari potzant èssere de carchi utilidade in carchi situatzione.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: B’est unu càrrigu pro tènnere prus de 2 passizeris, tando cust’optzione podet èssere prus cara de su netzessàriu.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antàrtide est su logu prus fritu de sa Terra, e inghìriat su Polo Sud.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Sas bìsitas turìsticas sunt caras, cherent a istare bene de carena, si podent fàghere petzi in istiu dae Santandria a Freàrgiu, e sunt limitadas pro su prus a sa penìsula, ìsulas e a su mare de Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Una pariga de mìgias de impiegados istant inoghe in istiu in unas bator dosinas de bases pro su prus in cuddos tretos; unu nùmeru prus minore si nch’abarrant in ierru.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Sas zona de intro de Antàrtide est una giara disconsolada cugugiada dae 2-3 km de ghiàciu.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Calchi ’òrta, biàgios aèreos ispetzializados movent conca a sas zonas de intro, pro artziare a monte o pro nde arrivire a su Polu, in ue b’at una base manna.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Sa South Pole Traverse (o Highway) est una carrera de 1600 km dae s’Istatzione McMurdo in su mare de Ross a su Polu.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Est nie cumpata cun gorropos prenos e signados cun banderas. Podet èssere percursa petzi dae tratores ispetzializados, chi batint islitas cun carburante e provistas.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Custos non sunt àgiles meda tando sa carrera depet pigare una deviatzione longa a fùrriu de sos Montes Transantàrticos pro lòmpere a sa pianura.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Sa càusa prus comune pro sos intzidentes in s’ierru sunt sos caminos, sos martzapiedes e prus che totu sas iscalinas liscinosas.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Comente mìnimu, dias dèpere impreare iscarpitas cun solas adatas. Sas iscarpitas de istadiale de sòlitu sunt liscinosas meda subra s’astrau e sa nie, fintzas carchi botas de ierru non sunt adecuadas.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Sa trama diat dèpere èssere bastante funduda, 5 mm (175 pòddighes) o prus, e su materiale bastante modde in sas temperaturas bassas.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Carchi botas tenent butones e b’est un’echipagiamentu agiuntivu abutonadu pro sas cunditziones liscinosas, adatu pro bona parte de iscarpitas e botas, pro sos tacos o tacos e sola.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Sos tacos diant dèpere èssere bassos e largos. S’arena, sa giarra o sa sale (cloruru de càlciu) sunt a s’ispissu isparghinados in su caminu pro megiorare sa tratzione.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Sas valangas non sunt un’anomalia; sos pendios ràbidos podent aguantare petzi a bellu meda, e sos volumes in prus ant a calare comente valangas.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Su problema est chi sa nie est poddosa, tando tenet bisòngiu de carchi istìmulu pro nde calare, e unu pagu de nie chi nde calat pode èssere s’eventu iscadenadore pro su restu.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: A bortas s’eventu iscadenadore est su sole chi callentat sa nie, a bortas àteras caladas de nie, a bortas àteros eventos naturales, a s’ispissu un’èssere umanu.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Unu trumunzone de bentu est una colunna de àera chi fùrriat a pressione bassa meda, chi nde suspit s’àera a fùrriu cara a intro e in artu.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Gènerant bentos fortes meda (a s’ispissu 100-200 mìglios a s’ora) e nde podent pesare ogetos graes in s’àera, batende·los comente si movet su trumunzone de bentu.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Cumintzant comente imbudos chi nde calant dae sas nues de istrachia, e diventant “trumunzone” cando tocant sa terra.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Sos frunidores de VPN personale (rete virtuale privada) sunt una manera etzellente de azirare siat sa tzensura polìtica siat sos filtros geogràficos de sos IP.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Sunt superiores a sos serbidores intermediàrios pro paritzas resones: torrant a deretare totu su tràficu ìnternet, no isceti s’http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Normalmente frunint una largària de banda prus arta e una mezus calidade de servìtziu. Sunt criptadas e tando prus malas a èssere ispiadas.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Sas cumpangias de media in manera regulare non narant sa beridade subra de su fine de custu, afirmende chi est pro “evitare sa pirateria”.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Difatis, sos còdighes de regione non tenent efetu perunu in sas còpias illegales; una còpia bit pro bit de unu discu at a funtzionare bene in cale si siat dispositivu in ue diat funtzionare s’originale.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Su fine reale est de dare a custas cumpangias prus controllu de sos mercados issoro; est totu chistione de fàghere zirare dinare.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Sigomente sas mutidas sunt deretadas in totu s’ìnternet, non tenes bisòngiu de una cumpangia de telèfonu chi siat in ue bives o in ue biazas.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Non bi sunt rechisitos pro otènnere unu nùmeru locale dae sa comunidade in ue bives; podes otènnere una connessione ìnternet satellitare in sas terras ispèrdidas de Chicken, Alaska, e seletzionare unu nùmeru chi narat chi ses in su sole de Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: A s’ispissu, depes comporare unu nùmeru globale a parte chi permitit a sos telèfonos PSTN de ti mutire. Su logu dae in ue benet su nùmeru faghet sa diferèntzia pro sas persones chi ti mutint.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Sas aplicatziones de tradutzione de testu in tempus reale - aplicatziones capatzes de traduire in manera automàtica segmentos intreos de testu dae una limba a s’àtera.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Calecuna de custas aplicatziones in custa categoria podet traduire fintzas testos in limbas istranzas in signos o àteros ogetos de su mundu reale cando s’utente ponet su telèfonu cara a custos ogetos.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Sa tecnologia pro sa tradutzione at megioradu in manera ispantosa, e como a s’ispissu frunit tradutziones prus o mancu curretas (e meda prus pagu limbàgios chi non si cumprendet), ma serbit atentzione, ca diant pòdere intepretare totu male a su matessi.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Una de sas aplicatziones prus connotas in custa categoria est Google Translate, chi permitit sa tradutzione foras de lìnia a pustis de àere iscarrigadu sos datos de sa limba disizada.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Impreare sas aplicatziones de navigatzione GPS in su telèfonu tou podet èssere sa manera prus fàtzile e cumbeniente pro navigare cando ses foras dae su paisu tuo de orìgine.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Podet fàghere risparmiare su dinare pro comporare mapas noas pro unu GPS, o unu dispositivu GPS indipendente o nde afitare unu dae una cumpangia de nolègiu de veturas.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Si non tenes una connessione datos pro su telèfonu tou, o cando est foras dae su raju, sas prestatziones podent èssere limitadas o no a disponimentu.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Cada butega est prena de unu muntone pagu craru de cartas telefònicas prepagadas chi podent èssere impreadas dae telèfonos a pagamentu o telèfonos comunes.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Mentras una parte manna de sas cartas andant bene pro mutire dae totue, calicuna est ispetzìfica pro frunire frecuèntzias de mutida favoriles pro unu grupu ispetzìficu de paisos.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: S’atzessu a custos servìtzios a s’ispissu s’impreat cun unu nùmeru birde chi podet èssere mutidu dae bona parte de sos telèfonos sena costos.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Sas règulas subra de sa fotografia regulare s’aplicant puru a sa registratzione de vìdeo, si est possìbile fintzas de prus.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Si fàghere una fotografia de carchi cosa no est permìtidu, tando non dias dèpere mancu pensare de nde registrare unu vìdeu.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Si ses impreende unu drone, controlla bene in antis ite est permìtidu a filmare e cales permissos o litzèntzias agiuntivas sunt rechertas.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Fàghere bolare unu drone acanta de un’aeroportu o subra una cantidade de gente est casi semper un’idea mala, mancari non siat illegale in sa zona tua.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Oe in die su biazu aèreu est prenotadu petzi pagas bortas deretu cun sa cumpangia sena àere antis chircadu e comparadu sos prètzios.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: A bortas su matessi bolu podet tènnere prètzios diferentes meda in vàrios portales ìnternet e est ùtile a cunfrontare sos resurtados de chirca e fintzas a pompiare in su situ de sa cumpangia etotu in antis de prenotare.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Mentras non dias dèpere tènnere bisòngiu de unu vistu pro vìsitas curtzas comente turista o pro afàrios in carchi paisu, a andare comente istudiante internatzionale rechedet in generale unu tempus prus longu pro istare de cando si andat isceti comente turista ocasionale.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: In generale, istare in unu paisu istranzu pro unu tempus longu at a rechèdere de otènnere unu vistu in antis.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Sos vistos de istudiante in generale tenent requisitos e protzeduras de aplicatzione diferentes dae sos vistos turìsticos o pro afàrios.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Pro una parte manna de sos paisos, as a tènnere bisòngiu de una lìtera de offerta dae s’istitutzione in ue cheres istudiare, e fintzas sa proa de su dinari pro ti suportare pro a su mancu su primu annu de su cursu.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Controlla cun s’istitutzione, e cun su dipartimentu de immigratzione pro su paisu in ue cheres istudiare pro rechisitos detalliados.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Si non ses unu diplomàticu, traballare a s’àtera parte de su mare cheret nàrrere chi as a dèpere pagare sas impostas in su paisu in ue tenes sa sede.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: S’imposta subra de su rèdditu est istruturada in manera diferente in paisos diversos, e sas cuotas de imposta e sas fascas càmbiant meda dae unu paisu a s’àteru.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: In carchi paisu federale, comente Istados Unidos e Cànada, s’imposta subra su rèdditu est incassada siat a livellu federale siat a livellu locale, tando sas cuotas e sas fascas podent cambiare dae regione a regione.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Mentras su controllu de immigratzione de sòlitu est assente o una formalidade cando arribas in su paisu tou, sos controllos de dogana podent èssere unu segamentu.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Assegura·ti de ischire ite podes o non podes batire e decrara cale si siat cosa subra sos lìmites legales.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Sa manera prus fàtzile de cumintzare in su setore de iscritura de biazu est de perfetzionare sas abilidades tuas in unu blog de biazu istabilidu.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Cando as a èssere de àju cun sa formatatzione e s’editing in ìnternet, tando a pustis dias pòdere creare su situ tou.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Fàghere su voluntàriu in biazu est una manera bella a beru de fàghere sa diferèntzia ma no est isceti chistione de dare.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Istare e fàghere voluntariadu in unu paisu istranzu est una manera bella de connòschere una cultura diferente, atobiare persones noas, ischire de prus subra de te etotu, otènnere unu sentidu de prospetiva e fintzas imparare abilidades noas.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Podet èssere puru una manera bella pro crèschere una summa pro permìtere unu tempus prus longu in carchi logu ca medas traballos pro volunteris frunint allògiu e vitu e calecunu pagat unu salàriu mìnimu.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Sos vichingos impreaiant sos canales de abba russos pro lòmpere a su Mare Nieddu e a su Mare Càspiu. Partes de custos caminos podent galu èssere impreados. Controlla sas possìbiles netzessidades pro permissos ispetziales, chi podent èssere difìtziles de otènnere.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Su Canale Mare Biancu-Bàlticu connetit s’Oceanu Àrticu a su Mare Bàlticu, tràmite su Lagu Onega, su Lagu Ladoga e San Pietroburgo, pro unu bellu tretu cun rios e lagos.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Su Lagu Onega est collegadu finas a su Volga, tando lòmpere dae su Mare Càspiu passende dae sa Rùssia est galu possìbile.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Assegura·ti chi cando lompes in sos portos totu podet èssere bastante òviu. As a addobiare àteros firmadores de nae e ant a cumpartzire sas informatziones issoro cun tegus.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: In sa pràtica as a apicare avisos oferrende s’agiudu tou, andende dae una parte a s’àtera de sos molos, acostende·ti a chie lìmpiat su pànfilu sou, proende a pigare cuntatu cun sos marinajos in sos bar, etc.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Chirca de chistionare cun prus gente possìbile. A pustis de pagu tempus totus t’ant a connòschere e t’ant a dare sas indicatzione subra de cale barca est chirchende a chie.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Dias dèpere seberare cun atentzione sa cumpangia aèrea Frequent Flyer in un’alleàntzia.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Mancari potzas pensare chi est intuitivu a intrare in sa cumpangia aèrea cun sa chi bolas de prus, dias dèpere ischire chi sos vantàgios ofertos a s’ispissu sunt diferentes e sos puntos de cliente frecuente podent èssere prus generosos suta una cumpangia diferente in sa matessi alleàntzia.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Cumpangias comente Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines ant ammaniadu meda sos servìtzios pro s’Àfrica e frunint collegamentos cun medas de sas tzitades printzipales africanas cun prètzios cumpetitivos cun àteras cumpangias aèreas europeas.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines bolat in 39 destinatziones in 30 paisos africanos dae su 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Si tenes tempus de biazu in prus, controlla pro bìdere comente sa cuota de tarifa tua pro s’Àfrica si cunfrontat cun una tarifa a fùrriu de su mundu.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: No iscaressas de agiùnghere sos costos a parte pro vistos aditzionales, impostas de partèntzia, trasportos de terra, etc. pro totu sos logos foras de Àfrica.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Si cheres bolare a inghìriu de su mundu totu in s’emisferu sud, su sèberu de bolos e destinatziones est limitadu pro more de sa mancàntzia de tretos transotzeànicos.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Peruna alleàntzia de cumpangias aèreas coberret totu sas rugraduras de sos tres otzèanos in s’emisferu sud (e SkyTeam non coberret peruna rugradura).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: De cada manera, Star Alliance coberret totu francu su sud-est de su Patzìficu dae Santiago de Tzile a Tahiti, chi est unu bolu LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Custu bolu no est s’ùnica optzione si boles sartiare su Patzìficu de sud e sa costa ovest de su Sudamèrica. (càstia subra)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: In su 1994, sa regione ètnica armena de Nagorno-Karabakh de Azerbaigian at cumbàtidu una gherra contras sos azeros.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Cun su suportu armenu, fiat istada creada una repùblica noa. De cada manera, peruna natzione costituida - nemancu s’Armènia - la reconnoschet ufitzialmente.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Sas cuntierras diplomàticas subra sa regione sighint a cumpromìtere sas relatziones intre Armènia e Azerbaigian.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Su Distretu de su Canale (Olandesu: Grachtengordel) est su distretu famadu de su de 17 sèculos chi inghìriat su Binnenstad de Àmsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Totu su distrettu est indicadu comente unu situ patrimòniu mundiale UNESCO pro su balore culturale e istòricu ùnicu sou, e sos balores de propiedade suos sunt intre sos prus artos de su paisu.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, chi cheret nàrrere Chimbe Terras, includet sas chimbe biddas piticas de costa de Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza e Monterosso postas in sa regione italiana de sa Ligùria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Sunt iscritas in sa lista de su patrimòniu mundiale UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: In sos sèculos, sa gente at fraigadu cun atentzione terratzas in su territòriu àsperu e ràbisu pròpiu subra de sas rocas chi s’afatzant a su mare.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Una parte de s’incantu sou est sa mancàntzia de un’isvilupu de azienda visìbile. Caminos, trenos e barcas collegant sas biddas, e sas veturas non bi podent lòmpere dae foras.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Sas variedades de frantzesu chi sunt faeddadas in Bèlgiu e in Isvìtzera sunt unu pagu diferentes dae su frantzesu faeddadu in Frantza, de cada manera sunt bastante sìmiles pro si cumprèndere a pare.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: In particulare, su sistema de sos nùmeros in su frantzesu de Bèlgiu e Isvìtzera tenet carchi particularidade unu pagu diferente dae su frantzesu faeddadu in Frantza, e sa pronùntzia de carchi paràula est diferente de pagu.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Mancari gasi, totu sos belgas e isvìtzeros chi faeddant frantzesu diant àere dèpidu imparare su frantzesu istandard in s’iscola, tando ti diant dèpere pòdere cumprèndere fintzas si impreas su sistema de nùmeros frantzesu istandard.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: In medas partes de su mundu, isbentulare sa manu est unu gestu de amistade, chi indicat “salude”.
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: De cada manera, in Malèsia, a su mancu intre sos Maleses in sas àrea rurales, cheret nàrrere “bene inoghe”, sìmile a su didu ìnditze pinnigadu cara a su corpus, unu gestu chi est impreadu in carchi paisu otzidentale, e diat dèpere èssere impreadu petzi cun cussu fine.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: In una manera sìmile, unu biazadore britànnicu in Ispagna diat pòdere confùndere unu saludu cun su palmu de sa manu cara a chie l’isbentulat (e non cara a chie retzit su saludu) comente unu gestu pro torrare a coa.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Sas limbas ausiliàrias sunt limbas artifitziales o fraigadas creadas cun su fine de fàghere prus fàtzile sa comunicatzione intre persones chi in àtera manera diant tènnere dificultades a comunicare.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Sunt diferentes dae sas limbas francas, chi sunt limbas naturales o orgànicas chi divennent dominantes pro una resone o s’àtera comente mezos de comunicatzione intre persones chi faeddant àteras limbas.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: In sa calura de sa die, sos biazadores podent isperimentare mirazos chi dant s’illusione de s’abba (o àteras cosas).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Custu podet èssere periculosu si su biazadore chircat su mirazu, isperditzende energia pretziosa e s’abba chi abarrat.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Fintzas su prus callente de sos desertos podet divènnere fritu a s’estremu a su note. S’ipotermia est unu riscu reale sena bestidos callentes.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: In s’istadiale, mescamente, as a dèpere fàghere atentzione a su muschitu si detzides de fàghere escursiones in sa foresta pluviale.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Fintzas si ses ghiende in sa foresta subtropicale, pagos segundos cun sas ghennas abertas mentras intras in sa vetura podent èssere unu tempus sufitziente pro su muschitu pro intrare in sa vetura cun tegus.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: S’inflèntzia de sos pillones, o naradu prus formale influèntzia aviària, podet infetare siat sos pillones siat sos mamìferos.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Apenas prus pagu de milli casos sunt istados riferidos in sos umanos, ma calecunu de custos est istadu fatale.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Bona parte ant interessadu persones chi traballant cun sas puddas, ma b’at carchi riscu puru pro chi faghet osservatzione de is pillones.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Tìpicos pro sa Norvègia sunt sos fiordos e sas baddes ràbidas chi totinduna lassant logu a una pianura arta, prus o mancu pare.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Custas pianuras sunt a s’ispissu definidas comente “vidde”, chi cheret nàrrere un’ispatziu ampru, abertu e sena matas, una distesa sena làcanas.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: In Rogaland e Agder de sòlitu sunt numenados “hei” chi cheret nàrrere una stovina sena matas a s’ispissu coberta de brugu.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Sos astraos non sunt istàbiles, ma iscurrint suta de su monte. Custu càusat afiladuras, gorropos, chi podent èssere cuados dae pontes de nie.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Sos muros e sas coberturas de sas grutas podent derrùere e sas afiladuras si podent serrare.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: In sa punta de s’astrau blocos mannos si lìberant, nde calant e forsis sàrtiant o ròdulant a tesu dae sa punta.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: S’istagione turìstica pro sas istatziones de collina in generale lompet a su màssimu durante s’istadiale indianu.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: De cada manera, tenent una genia diferente de bellesa e incantu durante s’ierru, cun medas istatziones de collina chi retzint cantidades mannas de nie e frunint atitvidades comente su iscì e su snowboarding.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Petzi pagas cumpangias aèreas frunint galu tarifas de lutu, chi faghent unu pagu de iscontu pro su costu de unu biazu de s’urtimu momentu pro unu funerale.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Sas cumpangias chi frunint custu includent Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa pro bolos chi partint dae sos USA o Cànada, e WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: In cada casu, depes prenotare pro telèfonu deretu cun sa cumpangia.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
